66414.recognize_zh: GMS 銀染下，綠色背景中可見大量黑色、極細且分支的絲狀菌，交織成團並呈放射狀向外延伸；菌絲寬度遠小於真菌菌絲，這種細絲狀分支細菌聚落符合放線菌（Actinomyces）菌落。
features: Dense black GMS-positive masses of very thin (under 1 um), branching filaments
Filaments radiate outward at the colony periphery and form tangled clumps
Filament width is far narrower than fungal hyphae, with no septate broad hyphae, yeast forms, or spores
Scattered short fragmented filaments in the adjacent light green counterstained debris
Background of green-stained inflammatory debris and fibrin
66414.describe_en: GMS-stained section of the peritoneal nodule shows dense black-staining colonies composed of innumerable very thin, branching filaments that radiate outward at the periphery and form tangled clumps. The filaments are markedly narrower than fungal hyphae, and no broad septate hyphae, yeasts, or spores are identified. The surrounding light green counterstain highlights inflammatory debris with scattered short filament fragments. In conjunction with the sulfur granule on H&E and Gram positivity, findings are consistent with Actinomyces colonies of actinomycosis; the filing of this image under fungi reflects the silver stain rather than a fungal organism.

ddx.vs: Nocardia filaments are also GMS-positive and branching but are beaded, rarely form compact granules, and are positive on modified acid-fast stain.
Aspergillus hyphae are 3-6 um wide with regular septation and acute-angle branching, much broader than these thin bacterial filaments.
Fungal grains are composed of broad septate hyphae with swollen chlamydospores rather than delicate filaments under 1 um.

ddx.dx: Reticulin or elastic fibers highlighted by silver
ddx.vs: Connective tissue fibers are continuous, non-radiating strands within stroma rather than discrete colonies of short branching filaments.

66350.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有兩個細胞質淡粉紅、含顆粒碎屑與空泡的巨噬細胞，周圍緊密圍繞著一圈核圓、染色質濃縮、細胞質深藍的紅血球前驅細胞，形成雙中心的紅血球島（erythroblastic island，俗稱 nurse cell）。
features: Two central macrophages with ill-defined pale pink-violet granular cytoplasm containing vacuoles and phagocytosed debris
Numerous erythroid precursors clustered around and upon the macrophage cytoplasm in a rosette-like island
Erythroblasts are round with high N:C ratio, round nuclei with coarse condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Precursors appear at similar maturation stages (mainly basophilic to polychromatic normoblasts) without megaloblastic change
Background of red cells; slightly thick area with blue-green tint limits fine detail
66350.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive erythroblastic island centered on two macrophages with pale granular cytoplasm containing vacuoles and phagocytic debris. The macrophages are surrounded by numerous erythroid precursors, predominantly basophilic and polychromatic normoblasts with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. No megaloblastic or dyserythropoietic features, hemophagocytosis of intact cells, or atypical cells are evident. Findings are consistent with normal erythroblastic islands (nurse cells) of active erythropoiesis.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor cluster
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are cohesive with nuclear molding, fine chromatin and lack a central macrophage, whereas erythroid islands show maturing normoblasts around a histiocyte.
In hemophagocytosis intact erythroblasts, red cells or leukocytes are engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm, not merely clustered around it.
Lymphocytes have scant pale blue cytoplasm and clumped chromatin without the deep basophilia and progressive hemoglobinization of normoblasts.

66094.recognize_zh: 尿液沉渣抹片中可見數顆含橘紅色粗顆粒、雙葉核的細胞（上方中央與右上方最清楚），為嗜酸性球；但畫面中其他多數顆粒球已退化、核染色質糊化，顆粒顏色不易辨認，影像解析度也有限，只能確認部分細胞為嗜酸性球。
features: Several granulocytes in a urine sediment preparation, many with bilobed or segmented nuclei
At least two cells show distinct coarse orange-red cytoplasmic granules consistent with eosinophils (top center and upper right)
Many other granulocytes are degenerated with smudged, coarsely granular nuclei and indistinct cytoplasmic granules, limiting eosinophil versus neutrophil distinction
A pale blue granular cell and amorphous proteinaceous material at left; a few small dark objects (possible bacteria/debris)
Image is soft-focus with limited resolution
66094.describe_en: Cytocentrifuged urine sediment (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows numerous granulocytes, several of which have bilobed nuclei and coarse orange-red cytoplasmic granules consistent with eosinophils. Many of the remaining cells are degenerated, with smudged nuclei and poorly preserved granules, so the eosinophil fraction cannot be reliably quantified from this image, and focus is limited. The presence of urinary eosinophils is compatible with eosinophiluria, which may be seen in acute interstitial nephritis among other renal and urinary tract inflammatory conditions, although it is neither sensitive nor specific.

ddx.vs: Neutrophils have fine lilac granules and 3-5 lobed nuclei, typically accompanied by bacteria, whereas eosinophils have larger orange-red refractile granules and bilobed nuclei; degenerated cells can be indistinguishable.
Tubular cells are larger with a single round nucleus and granular grey cytoplasm without segmented nuclei or orange granules.
Aging neutrophils can acquire pinkish cytoplasm, but lack discrete coarse orange granules; a Hansel stain helps confirm true eosinophils.

66286.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆比中性球略大的細胞，細胞核分成兩葉、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質佈滿均勻、粗大的橘紅色顆粒；雙葉核加上整片橘紅色嗜酸顆粒，就是成熟嗜酸性球（eosinophil）。背景血小板數量充足。
features: Mature granulocyte slightly larger than a neutrophil (about 12-15 µm)
Bilobed nucleus with two rounded lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge and coarse, condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm packed with uniform, coarse, refractile orange-red eosinophilic granules that do not obscure the nucleus
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic; numerous normal-sized platelets
66286.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature eosinophil with a characteristic bilobed nucleus with condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm filled with uniform coarse orange-red granules. The surrounding red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets are adequate in number and normal in size. This is a normal mature eosinophil; clinical significance depends on the absolute eosinophil count.

ddx.vs: Toxic neutrophils have 3-5 nuclear lobes and dark purple-blue fine granules rather than a bilobed nucleus with coarse orange-red granules.
Basophil granules are dark purple-black, variable in size and overlie and obscure the nucleus.
Immature eosinophils have round or indented non-segmented nuclei and often admixed purplish immature granules.
Neoplastic eosinophils may show hypogranularity, vacuolation, hypo- or hyperlobation, none of which is present in this normal-appearing cell.

66222.recognize_zh: 視野中兩顆小至中型淋巴球，核圓、染色質濃縮，細胞質量中等且偏向一側，邊緣長出短而細的絨毛狀突起（polar villous projections），是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的絨毛淋巴球；突起集中於一極而非環繞整圈，可與毛細胞白血病區分。
features: Small to medium lymphocytes with round nuclei and condensed, clumped chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Moderate amount of basophilic cytoplasm, slightly eccentric
Short, fine cytoplasmic villous projections concentrated at one pole or part of the cell border
A third similar lymphoid cell at the left edge and another at the lower edge
Background red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; few platelets
66222.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells and several small to medium lymphoid cells. The lymphoid cells have round nuclei with condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm bearing short villous projections that are predominantly polar rather than circumferential. No prominent nucleoli or plasmacytoid features are identified. Findings are consistent with circulating villous lymphocytes of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; confirmation requires flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal CD5-negative, CD10-negative, CD103-negative B-cell population.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have circumferential fine hair-like projections, more abundant pale cytoplasm and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with spongy chromatin.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: These cells have a single conspicuous central nucleolus and circumferential villi, unlike the inconspicuous nucleoli here.
CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm and block-like clumped chromatin without cytoplasmic projections, and smudge cells are common.

ddx.dx: Drying or spreading artifact of normal lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Artifactual crenation affects cells at the thin edge of the smear and is irregular, whereas true villous lymphocytes are reproducible across the monolayer.

65966.recognize_zh: 高倍下小型淋巴球核圓、染色質呈粗塊狀（足球樣/龜裂土樣，soccer ball / cracked earth），細胞質極少，並可見一顆核被抹開成條紋狀的 smudge cell，是 CLL 的典型抹片表現。
features: Small to slightly enlarged lymphocytes with a high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Round nuclei with coarsely clumped, block-like chromatin (soccer ball / cracked earth pattern)
No conspicuous nucleoli in most cells
Smudge cell with streaked, smeared nuclear chromatin in the center
Some lymphocytes with irregular, crumpled outlines (smear artifact)
Background red cells with numerous echinocytes (crenation artifact)
65966.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped block-like chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. A smudge cell with smeared, streaked nuclear material is present in the center of the field. Background red cells show numerous crenated forms, likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia, supported by the reported CD5+/CD19+/CD23+/CD200+ B-cell phenotype on flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: MCL cells tend to be more irregular with notched nuclei and are CD23/CD200 negative with cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity.
Prolymphocytes are larger with more cytoplasm and a single prominent central nucleolus, and smudge cells are less characteristic.
FL cells are small with deeply cleaved (buttock) nuclei and are CD10+/CD5- with t(14;18).
Reactive small lymphocytes are polyclonal and smudge cells are few, whereas CLL shows a monotonous clonal population with abundant smudge cells.

65646.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一群大型非典型細胞，細胞質豐富呈嗜鹼性藍色、部分含小空泡，核不規則、有摺痕或分葉，染色質細緻並可見核仁，大小遠超過旁邊的小淋巴球；這種非典型大細胞群要懷疑淋巴增生性疾病。
features: Cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells with moderate N:C ratio
Irregular, folded, indented to lobulated nuclei
Fine to open chromatin with one or more nucleoli
Abundant basophilic blue cytoplasm, some with small vacuoles
Several crushed/disrupted cells with reticular chromatin; small lymphocytes and a platelet aggregate nearby
Hemodilute background
65646.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hemodilute and shows a cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells with abundant basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular, folded to lobulated nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli. Several cells are disrupted. Small mature lymphocytes and platelets are present, and normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. The atypical cells are markedly larger than the background lymphocytes and are not lineage-specific on morphology. In the reported context of EBV positivity in these cells, findings are concerning for an EBV-associated lymphoproliferative disorder, and immunophenotyping on tissue is required.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes also have folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, but they are nonspecific esterase- and CD14/CD64-positive and usually present in greater numbers.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with molding and cytokeratin positivity, whereas these cells are discohesive lymphoid-like cells.
ALCL hallmark cells have kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nuclei with strong CD30 in nearly all cells, while here CD30 is only scattered and ALK is negative.

65902.recognize_zh: 視野中聚集許多漿細胞：核偏於一側、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質豐富呈灰藍色並有核旁淡染區（hof）；右下一顆大型細胞含三個核，屬多核漿細胞。影像對焦不佳，細節有限。
features: Cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Coarse clumped chromatin; perinuclear hof visible in several cells
Large multinucleated (trinucleate) plasma cell at lower right
Variation in plasma cell size with some immature-appearing forms
Occasional neutrophil and a clear vacuole/fat space; image is out of focus with color cast, limiting assessment of nucleoli
65902.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin, perinuclear hofs and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm. Plasma cells vary in size, and a large trinucleate plasma cell is present. A neutrophil is seen at the edge of the cluster. Suboptimal focus and color balance limit evaluation of nucleoli and cytoplasmic inclusions. Sheets of plasma cells with multinucleated forms are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm; the plasma cell percentage and clonality (κ/λ restriction, serum/urine M-protein) are needed for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, scattered or perivascular and polytypic, and rarely form sheets with multinucleated forms.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.
Plasmablasts are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli, unlike these mostly mature-appearing plasma cells.

65710.recognize_zh: 低倍下粉紅色骨小樑明顯增厚且不規則吻合成網，佔據大部分視野，骨髓腔被壓縮，內為疏鬆纖維化基質與擴張血竇，造血細胞稀少；這是骨髓纖維化晚期的骨硬化（osteosclerosis）。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bone trabeculae occupying most of the section
Trabecular bone shows irregular cement lines and appositional new bone formation
Compressed intertrabecular spaces filled with loose fibrotic/edematous stroma containing spindle cells
Numerous dilated thin-walled sinusoids and vascular spaces within the marrow stroma
Marked reduction of hematopoietic cells; only a small cellular focus at the lower left
65710.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows extensive osteosclerosis, with broad, irregular and anastomosing bone trabeculae that occupy the majority of the section and show irregular cement lines. The intervening marrow spaces are narrowed and replaced by loose fibrotic stroma with spindle cells and dilated sinusoids, and residual hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Reticulin and trichrome stains would be required to grade fibrosis. In the context of primary myelofibrosis with pancytopenia and massive splenomegaly, findings are consistent with advanced (fibrotic) stage disease with osteosclerosis (MF-3).

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: The marrow histology is indistinguishable, and separation relies on the documented prior history of PV or ET.
Renal osteodystrophy shows peritrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclasts and dissecting resorption rather than clustered atypical megakaryocytes, with normal JAK2/CALR/MPL.
Osteoblastic metastases (e.g. prostate, breast) contain cohesive epithelial clusters confirmed by keratin immunostaining.
Osteopetrosis shows retained calcified cartilage cores within trabeculae and lacks marrow fibrosis with atypical megakaryocytes.

65006.recognize_zh: 肋膜液流式細胞散點圖：A 圖紅色族群 CD38 與 CD138 皆強陽性（漿細胞）；B 圖這群 CD19 陰性；C 圖 CD56 陽性；D 圖紅色族群沿 lambda 軸偏移、kappa 相對較低，代表 lambda 輕鏈限制。CD19 陰性、CD56 陽性加上輕鏈限制，即為異常克隆性漿細胞。
features: Panel A: discrete red population with bright CD38 and bright CD138, gated as plasma cells
Panel B: CD138-positive population is CD19-negative, unlike the separate CD19-positive CD138-negative B-cell cluster
Panel C: CD138-positive population shows moderate to bright CD56 expression
Panel D: plasma cell population skewed toward lambda with lower kappa signal, interpreted as lambda restriction
Scale is log fluorescence; gray events represent other viable cells
65006.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of pleural fluid shows a large discrete population of plasma cells with bright CD38 and CD138 expression. This population lacks CD19 and shows moderate to bright CD56, an aberrant immunophenotype characteristic of neoplastic plasma cells. The kappa versus lambda plot shows the plasma cell population shifted toward lambda with relatively lower kappa signal, consistent with lambda light chain restriction, although the diagonal spread suggests some nonspecific binding and cytoplasmic light chain staining is the preferred confirmatory method for plasma cells. Findings are consistent with clonal plasma cells involving the pleural fluid, supporting myelomatous pleural effusion.

ddx.vs: Normal plasma cells are CD19-positive and CD56-negative with a mixed kappa and lambda distribution.
LPL plasma cells are typically CD19-positive and CD56-negative and accompanied by a clonal CD20-positive B-cell population.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares CD38/CD138 positivity and CD19 negativity but consists of large immunoblastic cells, often EBER-positive, with a high Ki-67 index.

65454.recognize_zh: 中央這顆顆粒球的核呈甜甜圈狀，中間有一個淡色的圓孔，染色質粗而成塊，細胞質淡粉紫色帶細顆粒。核成環狀、中央有孔（不是單純分葉重疊）就是 ring neutrophil，可見於 MDS、白血病或巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Granulocyte with a doughnut-shaped (ring) nucleus enclosing a central pale hole
Coarse, condensed mature chromatin around the ring
Rim of pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with fine granules
Cell size close to that of a neutrophil or slightly smaller
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytes), likely an artifact of smear preparation
65454.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte whose nucleus forms a continuous ring around a central clear hole, with condensed chromatin and a rim of pale, finely granular cytoplasm. Background red cells show diffuse crenation, most likely artifactual. The nuclear configuration represents a ring (doughnut) neutrophil or ring-form granulocyte. This finding is non-specific but may be seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms, myeloid leukemias, megaloblastic anemia and drug effects; correlation with the rest of the smear and clinical history is recommended.

ddx.vs: Overlapping lobes show focal separation and filaments on fine focusing, whereas a ring nucleus is a continuous band surrounding a clear central space.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more discrete lobes, while this nucleus is a single annular structure.
Pseudo-Pelger cells have a round unilobed or bilobed nucleus without a central hole.

ddx.dx: Ring-shaped nucleus in an erythroblast or lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Erythroblasts have basophilic to polychromatic agranular cytoplasm and lymphocytes a high N:C ratio, unlike the pale granular cytoplasm here.

65390.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現多顆中型、核偏位、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質深藍且有核周淡染區的漿細胞樣細胞，血液中出現這麼多漿細胞應考慮漿細胞白血病。
features: Circulating medium-sized plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in several cells
Chromatin coarse to clumped; nucleoli not conspicuous in most cells
Moderate to high N:C ratio in some cells, with narrow rims of cytoplasm
Background of peripheral red cells without prominent rouleaux in these crops
65390.describe_en: Composite peripheral blood smear images show multiple circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several with a perinuclear hof. Some cells have a higher N:C ratio with a narrow rim of cytoplasm, but distinct large nucleoli typical of plasmablasts are not clearly seen in these crops. Background red cells are unremarkable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with circulating clonal plasma cells as seen in plasma cell leukemia; diagnosis requires enumeration (5% or more circulating plasma cells by current criteria) and confirmation by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Reactive cells are heterogeneous in size with a spectrum to normal lymphocytes and are polytypic, rather than a monotonous clonal population.
Circulating cells are mostly small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P and CD19/CD20 expression, unlike CD138+/CD38 bright, CD19-negative plasma cells.
Cells are large with prominent central nucleoli and are often EBV-positive, lacking the clumped chromatin seen here.

64878.recognize_zh: 這是一張示意性的正常紅血球體積直方圖：單一對稱鐘形峰，峰頂約在 90 fL 對應 MCV，箭頭寬度標示 RDW；實線為中央 92% 族群界線，虛線分別位於 60 與 120 fL，用來計算小紅血球與大紅血球比例。
features: Schematic RBC volume histogram with frequency on the y-axis and cell volume (fL) on the x-axis
Single symmetric unimodal peak centered near 90 fL, marked as MCV
Horizontal double-headed arrow across the curve labeled RDW
Solid vertical lines bounding the central 92% of the population
Dashed vertical lines at 60 fL and 120 fL marking microcytic and macrocytic thresholds
64878.describe_en: This figure is a schematic of a normal impedance red cell volume histogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows a single, symmetric population of red cells centered at about 90 fL, from which the MCV is derived, with the width of the distribution represented as the RDW. Solid lines mark the central 92% of the population, and dashed lines at 60 fL and 120 fL allow quantification of the percentages of microcytic and macrocytic cells. It serves as the reference against which abnormal histograms, such as the schistocyte and reticulocyte populations in TTP, are compared.

65198.recognize_zh: 影像上後腹腔含脂肪的腫塊，粗針切片可見三系造血細胞（含巨核細胞）構成骨髓脂肪瘤；其中另有一群伴隨嗜酸性球的梭形/長形細胞聚集，CD117 與 CD25 陽性，提示異常肥大細胞（全身性肥大細胞增生症）。
features: PET-CT and axial CT: fat-containing retroperitoneal mass in the left lower abdomen (arrows) with low FDG avidity
H&E: trilineage hematopoietic elements including a megakaryocyte and erythroid/myeloid precursors adjacent to adipose tissue
Aggregate of spindle to elongated cells with oval nuclei and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with eosinophils
CD117 strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining in the aggregated cells
CD25 aberrant membranous positivity in the same cell population
65198.describe_en: Imaging shows a fat-containing retroperitoneal mass. Needle core biopsy shows adipose tissue with trilineage hematopoietic elements including megakaryocytes, consistent with myelolipoma. In addition, there is an aggregate of spindle-shaped cells with oval nuclei and pale cytoplasm associated with eosinophils; these cells are positive for CD117 with aberrant CD25 expression (tryptase positive per the report). Findings are consistent with myelolipoma involved by an abnormal mast cell aggregate, suspicious for systemic mastocytosis, which was confirmed on marrow and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.vs: EMH shows hematopoietic elements in organs such as spleen or liver in a patient with marrow failure or hemoglobinopathy, lacking the discrete mature adipose tumor mass of myelolipoma; neither explains CD25+ mast cells.
Liposarcoma shows atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and lipoblasts with MDM2 amplification rather than benign trilineage hematopoiesis.
Reactive mast cells are scattered, round and CD25 negative, whereas these are spindled, aggregated and CD25 positive.

ddx.dx: Eosinophil-rich spindle cell lesion (e.g., Langerhans cell histiocytosis)
ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved nuclei and are CD1a/langerin positive, not CD117/tryptase/CD25 positive.

65134.recognize_zh: 這是周邊血流式細胞圖：在 CD19+ B 細胞中圈出一小群 CD20 與 CD22 強表現、CD11c 強陽性的細胞，並共表現 CD25、CD103、CD123、CD200，數量極少，代表毛細胞白血病治療後的微量殘存疾病（MRD）。
features: Sequential gating: singlets, CD45 versus SSC, CD19-positive B cells with slightly higher SSC
Small cluster (black events) with bright CD20 and bright CD22 co-expressing bright CD11c (P3 gate)
P3 events co-express CD25, CD103, CD123 and CD200, separating them from normal B cells (red events)
Light-chain plot shows the black events skewed to one light chain (lambda per description)
Very low event count consistent with low-level residual disease
65134.describe_en: Peripheral blood flow cytometry plots with sequential gating from singlets through CD45/SSC to CD19-positive B cells. A small discrete population is identified with bright CD20 and CD22, bright CD11c, and co-expression of CD25, CD103, CD123 and CD200, with light-chain skewing; residual normal B cells (red events) lack CD103, CD25 and CD123. The population is present at a very low frequency (0.04% of events per clinical history). Findings are consistent with minimal residual hairy cell leukemia after cladribine therapy.

ddx.vs: HCL-variant is typically CD25-negative and CD123-negative, whereas this residual population co-expresses CD25 and CD123.

ddx.dx: Normal/regenerating B cells (hematogones or naive B cells)
ddx.vs: Normal B cells are polytypic and lack CD103, CD25 and bright CD11c, as shown by the red background events.
SMZL may express CD11c or CD25 weakly but rarely shows the full CD103+/CD25+/CD123+/bright CD11c/CD200+ profile.

65070.recognize_zh: A 圖（EDTA 採血）低倍下可見多團大型血小板聚集，夾雜被困住的白血球；B 圖（檸檬酸鈉採血）同一病人的血小板則單顆均勻散布、無聚集，說明儀器計數的血小板低下是 EDTA 引起的假性血小板低下。
features: Panel A (EDTA): multiple large platelet clumps of dozens of platelets scattered along the smear
Panel A: leukocytes entrapped at the edge of the aggregates
Panel B (citrate): platelets evenly dispersed as single cells with no aggregates
Panel B: two neutrophils with normal segmented nuclei; red cells unremarkable at this power
Low-power ocular photographs; fine platelet morphology not assessable
65070.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears from the same patient are shown at low power. The EDTA-anticoagulated smear (A) contains numerous large platelet clumps with entrapped leukocytes, explaining the spuriously low automated platelet count of 25 x10^9/L. The citrate-anticoagulated smear (B) shows evenly dispersed single platelets without aggregates, corresponding to a smear-estimated count of about 140-150 x10^9/L. Red cells and neutrophils are unremarkable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia; the citrate count (corrected for dilution) should be reported and no treatment for thrombocytopenia is needed.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows few single platelets and no clumps in both EDTA and citrate samples, whereas clumps here disappear in citrate with a near-normal count.
Satellitism is also EDTA dependent but shows platelets rosetting around neutrophils rather than free-standing large aggregates.

ddx.dx: Clumping from traumatic or delayed collection (clotted sample)
ddx.vs: Pre-analytic clotting produces clumps with fibrin strands in any anticoagulant, whereas EDTA-dependent clumping resolves in a properly collected citrate tube.

64942.recognize_zh: 多顆紅血球失去中央淡染區、體積較小且緻密，表面有數目少、長短與間距不規則的棘狀突起，即棘狀紅血球（acanthocyte）；旁邊也混有突起較短而規則的皺縮細胞，需加以分辨。
features: Numerous dense red cells lacking central pallor with few, irregularly spaced spicules of variable length (acanthocytes)
Admixed crenated cells with more numerous short, regular projections (echinocyte-like)
Background normocytic red cells with preserved central pallor
One small mature lymphocyte with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Scattered platelets of normal appearance
64942.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (oil immersion) shows numerous acanthocytes: small, dense red cells without central pallor bearing a few irregularly distributed spicules of unequal length. Some cells with more uniform, short crenations resembling echinocytes are also present and should be distinguished from true acanthocytes. A small mature lymphocyte and normal-appearing platelets are seen. Findings are consistent with acanthocytosis; clinical correlation (liver disease, post-splenectomy state, abetalipoproteinemia, neuroacanthocytosis) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced, uniform projections around a cell that retains its size, whereas acanthocytes are dense with few irregular spicules of unequal length.

ddx.dx: Spur cell anemia of liver disease
ddx.vs: This is a clinical subtype of acanthocytosis with the same morphology; distinction relies on liver function and lipid studies.
Keratocytes have one or two horn-like projections flanking a vacuole-like notch, reflecting mechanical injury, rather than multiple irregular spicules.
Artifactual crenation is uniform and affects cells in thick areas, whereas true acanthocytes persist in thin areas and on repeat fresh smears.

64814.recognize_zh: 八格周邊血中多數異常細胞的核呈雙葉、蝴蝶狀或深凹摺（bilobed/butterfly），細胞質僅見稀疏細小顆粒甚至近乎無顆粒，這種「核型怪、顆粒少」的組合正是微顆粒型 APL（M3v）的線索。
features: Medium to large cells with bilobed, butterfly-shaped or deeply folded/reniform nuclei
Fine, relatively dispersed chromatin with occasional visible nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue to lilac cytoplasm with sparse fine azurophilic granules or appearing agranular
No readily identified Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) in these fields
Monotonous population replacing normal leukocytes; background erythrocytes and scattered platelets
64814.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium to large abnormal cells with characteristic bilobed, butterfly-shaped or deeply folded nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and occasional nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate in amount and contains only sparse, fine azurophilic granules, with many cells appearing nearly agranular; Auer rod bundles are not evident in these fields. In a patient with marked leukocytosis and DIC, the findings are consistent with the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei too, but are MPO weak, nonspecific esterase positive and CD14/CD64/HLA-DR positive, whereas M3v cells are strongly MPO positive and HLA-DR/CD34 negative.
Cup-like blasts show a nuclear invagination rather than bilobed butterfly nuclei and lack PML::RARA.
Classic APL cells are packed with coarse azurophilic granules that obscure the nucleus and often contain faggot cells, whereas M3v shows sparse fine granules and high WBC.

ddx.dx: Sézary/large granular or other lymphoid cells with lobated nuclei
ddx.vs: Lymphoid cells lack azurophilic granules and MPO reactivity and have condensed chromatin or cerebriform nuclear folds.

64494.recognize_zh: 腎絲球呈分葉狀、細胞增生，微血管腔內（藍箭頭）可見圓形、均質、亮紅色的玻璃樣栓子（hyaline thrombus），在 CLL 相關冷球蛋白或單株免疫球蛋白腎病中可見；本圖染色外觀為三色染色（膠原呈藍色）而非 H&E。
features: Enlarged, hypercellular glomerulus with accentuated lobular architecture
Round, homogeneous, bright fuchsinophilic (red) intracapillary hyaline thrombus (arrow)
Endocapillary hypercellularity with mesangial expansion and narrowed capillary lumens
Blue-staining collagen in Bowman capsule and interstitium, indicating a trichrome-type stain
Additional smaller eosinophilic deposits within capillary loops
64494.describe_en: Renal biopsy section shows a hypercellular glomerulus with accentuated lobulation, endocapillary hypercellularity, and mesangial expansion with narrowing of capillary lumens. A round, homogeneous, brightly red-staining intracapillary deposit consistent with a hyaline (pseudo)thrombus is present (blue arrow), with smaller similar deposits in other loops. Although labeled H&E, the blue collagen and red deposits in this image indicate a trichrome-type stain. In a patient with CLL, findings are suggestive of immune-complex/paraprotein-mediated glomerular injury such as cryoglobulinemic glomerulonephritis; immunofluorescence and electron microscopy are required for classification.

ddx.vs: TMA shows fibrin thrombi with mesangiolysis, fragmented red cells, and endothelial swelling without immune deposits, whereas hyaline pseudothrombi are immunoglobulin aggregates with a membranoproliferative pattern.
Lupus can show hyaline thrombi and wire loops but has full-house immunofluorescence and serologic evidence of SLE.

ddx.dx: Proliferative GN with monoclonal IgG deposits
ddx.vs: Separation relies on immunofluorescence for light-chain restriction and cryoglobulin studies, as light microscopy overlaps.
Diabetic hyaline insudates (fibrin caps, capsular drops) occur with nodular mesangial sclerosis rather than hypercellular lobules with intraluminal globules.

64558.recognize_zh: BAL 抹片中有許多細胞質淡藍、呈泡沫狀的肺泡巨噬細胞，背景與細胞內散布大量洋紅至紫紅色、顆粒狀或團塊狀的無定形蛋白質物質，可解讀為界面活性物質豐富的板層小體（lamellar bodies），提示肺泡蛋白沉積症（PAP）。
features: Numerous alveolar macrophages with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated/foamy cytoplasm
Abundant extracellular magenta-purple granular to clumped amorphous proteinaceous material in the background
Similar magenta granular material within macrophage cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional larger cells with round nuclei; no organisms identified
Image focus and depth of field are limited (photomicrograph through eyepiece), precluding fine structural assessment
64558.describe_en: May-Grünwald-Giemsa-stained smear of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid shows numerous alveolar macrophages with abundant foamy, pale blue cytoplasm, together with abundant extracellular and intracytoplasmic magenta, granular to clumped amorphous proteinaceous material. Scattered lymphocytes are present, and no microorganisms are evident, although focus is limited. In a patient with milky BAL fluid and negative infectious workup, findings are suggestive of accumulated surfactant material (lamellar bodies), consistent with pulmonary alveolar proteinosis; PAS positivity and anti-GM-CSF antibody testing would support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: PJP forms foamy, alveolar-cast-like clusters containing small cyst/trophozoite dots highlighted by GMS or immunofluorescence, whereas this material is granular magenta debris and PJP testing was negative.
Lipid-laden macrophages have large clear cytoplasmic vacuoles that stain with Oil Red O, rather than dense magenta granular extracellular proteinaceous material.
Mucus forms strands and sheets with entrapped cells rather than discrete granular PAS-positive surfactant globules associated with foamy macrophages.
Siderophages contain coarse blue-black to golden-brown pigment positive with Prussian blue, whereas this material is magenta and extracellular.

64430.recognize_zh: 結膜組織被中型、染色質細緻、細胞質稀少的單一形態母細胞瀰漫浸潤，免疫染色 CD4、CD56、CD123、TCL1 皆瀰漫陽性，流式細胞儀顯示 CD45 弱、HLA-DR+、TdT+、CD34 陰性，組合起來指向母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Diffuse monotonous infiltrate of medium-sized blastoid cells effacing conjunctival stroma (panel B)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Interspersed thin fibrovascular stroma without epithelial nests or necrosis in this field
Diffuse strong positivity for CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1 by IHC (panels C-F), with perivascular sparing of vessel walls
Flow cytometry (panel A): CD45-dim, low-SSC population expressing CD4, CD56, HLA-DR and cytoplasmic TdT, negative for CD34, with dim CD117
64430.describe_en: Conjunctival biopsy shows diffuse infiltration by sheets of monotonous medium-sized blastoid cells with finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. By immunohistochemistry the neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1. Flow cytometry of the lesion identifies a CD45-dim, low side-scatter population expressing CD4, CD56, HLA-DR and TdT without CD34, CD3, CD19 or MPO. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm involving the ocular adnexa.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (myeloid sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML can be CD4+/CD56+ but usually expresses lysozyme, CD14/CD11c or MPO and lacks the strong CD123/TCL1/TCF4 co-expression of BPDCN.
ENKTL is CD56+ but angiodestructive, cytoplasmic CD3ε+, cytotoxic granule-positive and EBER-positive, unlike this EBER-negative CD123+/TCL1+ infiltrate.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT+ like this case but expresses CD3 or CD19/PAX5 and lacks CD123/TCL1 co-expression with CD4/CD56.
Merkel cell carcinoma is CD56+ but cytokeratin 20 dot-positive and CD45-negative.

64430.stain: H&E; IHC: CD4, CD56, CD123, TCL1; flow

64366.recognize_zh: 一團大型細胞，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色，帶有細纖維條紋狀（皺紙樣）紋理，核小而圓、偏心且染色質粗，這是典型 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Clustered large cells, several times the diameter of adjacent hematopoietic cells
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine fibrillary striations (crumpled tissue paper appearance)
Small, round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Some cells multinucleated or with overlapping nuclei
Occasional clear vacuoles; background marrow cells and red cells at the edges
64366.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large macrophages with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm displaying a fine fibrillary, wrinkled tissue paper texture. Nuclei are small, round to oval and eccentrically placed, with coarse chromatin; some cells appear binucleated. There are no discrete cytoplasmic granules or uniform foamy vacuolation. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells, and confirmation with glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity or GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells mimic this appearance in CML, myeloma, thalassemia and other high-turnover states, and are distinguished by normal glucocerebrosidase activity and the underlying disease.
Niemann-Pick cells have evenly foamy, soap-bubble vacuolated cytoplasm instead of fibrillary striations.
Histiocytes stuffed with atypical mycobacteria show negative-image rods and are acid-fast positive.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not small eccentric nuclei with striated blue cytoplasm.

64238.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑間有多個黏聚成巢狀、部分中央空洞的上皮細胞團，NKX3.1 呈強烈棕色核染色，周圍造血細胞陰性，符合轉移性攝護腺癌。
features: Multiple cohesive nests and sheets of tumor cells replacing marrow between bony trabeculae
Strong, diffuse nuclear (brown) NKX3.1 positivity in tumor cells, with some cytoplasmic blush
Some nests with central loosening/necrosis or lumen-like spaces
Surrounding hematopoietic marrow and adipocytes negative (internal negative control)
Decalcified trabecular bone fragments with blue counterstain; low-power view
64238.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy immunostained for NKX3.1 shows multiple cohesive nests of tumor cells infiltrating the intertrabecular spaces, some with central loosening or lumen-like spaces. The tumor cells show strong, diffuse nuclear NKX3.1 expression, while the background hematopoietic elements and adipocytes are negative. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma of prostatic origin involving the bone marrow, in the appropriate clinical and morphologic context.

ddx.vs: Breast carcinoma can occasionally express NKX3.1 (especially lobular) but is typically GATA3 positive and PSA/PSAP negative, so a confirmatory prostate panel is needed.
Urothelial carcinoma is NKX3.1 negative and GATA3, p63, and CK7/CK20 positive.
Colorectal carcinoma is NKX3.1 negative and CDX2, SATB2, and CK20 positive.
Neuroendocrine tumors show TTF-1/INSM1/synaptophysin positivity; treatment-emergent prostatic neuroendocrine carcinoma may lose NKX3.1 and PSA.

64174.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球在薄處仍大量疊成錢串狀排列（rouleaux），同時可見數顆中等大小、染色質較開放的單核淋巴樣細胞；「顯著錢串＋異常淋巴樣細胞」提示 IgM 單株蛋白增加的 Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症。
features: Prominent rouleaux: red cells stacked in chains in the thin area of the smear
Several medium-sized mononuclear lymphoid cells with round nuclei and more open chromatin than normal lymphocytes
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm in the lymphoid cells
Bluish background staining and scattered spherocyte-like cells
Platelets present
64174.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent rouleaux formation extending into the thin, monolayer area of the smear, along with a subtle bluish background. Several medium-sized mononuclear lymphoid cells with round nuclei, a more open chromatin pattern than normal small lymphocytes, and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm are present. Platelets are adequate. Findings are consistent with a paraproteinemia with circulating lymphoid cells, suggestive of Waldenström macroglobulinemia/lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma; serum protein electrophoresis with immunofixation and flow cytometry are recommended.

ddx.vs: Myeloma also causes rouleaux, but circulating cells are plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and hofs, and the paraprotein is usually IgG/IgA rather than IgM.
Agglutinates form irregular three-dimensional clumps rather than linear coin-like stacks, and disperse on warming.
Artifactual stacking is confined to thick areas, whereas true rouleaux persists in the thin area where cells should lie separately.
CLL cells have condensed soccer-ball chromatin with smudge cells and usually no significant rouleaux.

64046.recognize_zh: PAX8 染色中，大型異型細胞與背景小淋巴球的細胞核都呈棕色陽性；因為多株 PAX8 抗體會與 B 細胞的 PAX5 交叉反應，這個陽性不代表腎或甲狀腺癌轉移。
features: Nuclear PAX8 staining of large atypical cells with enlarged round nuclei (upper left)
Nuclear PAX8 staining also in a dense population of small background lymphocytes (lower right)
PAX8-negative stromal/histiocytic cells with blue counterstain
Staining of normal B cells indicates cross-reactivity (polyclonal PAX8 antibody recognizing PAX5)
64046.describe_en: PAX8 immunohistochemistry shows nuclear staining of the large atypical cells as well as of numerous small background lymphocytes, while stromal cells are negative. Positivity in non-neoplastic small B cells indicates cross-reactivity of the PAX8 antibody (particularly polyclonal clones) with the PAX5 epitope rather than true epithelial PAX8 expression. This is a recognized pitfall that can lead to a misdiagnosis of metastatic renal, thyroid, or Mullerian carcinoma. In context with CD45 and PAX5 positivity, the findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma with cross-reactive PAX8 staining.

ddx.vs: RCC is PAX8+ but also keratin+/CD10+ and CD45/PAX5 negative, and background lymphocytes would not stain with a monoclonal PAX8 antibody.
These co-express keratin with TTF-1/thyroglobulin or WT1/ER, respectively, and lack hematolymphoid markers.
Repeating with a monoclonal PAX8 antibody that does not cross-react with PAX5 should render the lymphoma cells negative.

63790.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見細胞界線不清、細胞質淡粉紅、核呈細長彎曲「拖鞋狀」的類上皮組織球聚集成團，周圍環繞小淋巴球，符合類上皮細胞肉芽腫（epithelioid granuloma）。
features: Central aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with indistinct cell borders and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Elongated, curved, slipper- or boomerang-shaped nuclei with vesicular chromatin
Peripheral rim of small round lymphocytes and occasional plasma cells
No multinucleated giant cells or caseous necrosis visible in this field
Background marrow hematopoiesis not identifiable here
63790.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows a cohesive aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, indistinct cell borders, and elongated slipper-shaped nuclei with vesicular chromatin. The aggregate is surrounded by small lymphocytes and occasional plasma cells. Multinucleated giant cells and necrosis are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with an epithelioid granuloma; Ziehl-Neelsen and fungal stains plus cultures should be performed to exclude infection.

ddx.vs: Forms tight non-necrotizing granulomas but is a diagnosis of exclusion requiring negative AFB/fungal stains and cultures.
Histiocytes contain small 2–4 µm yeast forms highlighted by GMS or PAS, rather than acid-fast bacilli.
Large CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells are present among the histiocytes.
Morphology overlaps; separated by clinical drug history and absence of organisms on stains and cultures.

63662.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以大量中等大小的淋巴樣細胞為主，核圓至卵圓、部分有凹陷，染色質細緻，淡藍色細胞質量中等且邊緣呈不規則的毛邊狀突起，與周邊血中的毛狀細胞相似。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to oval nuclei, some indented, with finely clumped chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular, frayed, fine hair-like margins
Few scattered small mature lymphocytes; normal hematopoietic precursors sparse in this field
Background red cells
63662.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and dominated by medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular, frayed hair-like borders. Normal hematopoietic precursors are sparse in this field and no blasts are seen. The cells resemble the circulating hairy cells, and findings are consistent with marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia. Because aspirates in hairy cell leukemia are often a dry tap owing to reticulin fibrosis, the core biopsy with immunohistochemistry remains essential.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have irregular nuclei but scant cytoplasm without hairy projections and show CD5 and strong cyclin D1 expression.
SMZL cells have more condensed chromatin and polar villi and are CD103 and annexin A1 negative.
HCL-variant cells show prominent central nucleoli and are CD25 negative.
Monocytes have folded nuclei and gray cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles.

63598.recognize_zh: 箭頭處小細胞的核內有一個圓形、淡紫粉紅、周圍被深色染色質環繞的包涵體（Dutcher body），背景為密集的小型淋巴樣細胞，是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤常考的形態線索。
features: Single cell with a round, pale pink-violet intranuclear pseudoinclusion rimmed by condensed chromatin (Dutcher body)
Dense background of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei and coarse chromatin
Moderate pale to vacuolated cytoplasm in many cells, some with plasmacytoid features
No sheets of large cells or increased mitoses in this field
Congested vessels with red cells at right edge
63598.describe_en: High-power H&E sections show a dense lymphoid infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells with coarse chromatin. A single cell contains a round, eosinophilic intranuclear pseudoinclusion consistent with a Dutcher body. There is no increase in large transformed cells in this field. Findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context; correlation with IgM paraprotein, light-chain restriction and MYD88 L265P status is recommended.

ddx.vs: MZL may contain Dutcher bodies but typically shows monocytoid/marginal zone B cells and follicular colonization, and usually lacks MYD88 L265P.
Myeloma lacks a clonal CD20+ small lymphocyte population and is composed of sheets of CD138+ plasma cells, often CD56+.

ddx.dx: Russell body or Mott cell plasmacytosis (reactive)
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are cytoplasmic globules displacing the nucleus, whereas Dutcher bodies overlie the nucleus as intranuclear invaginations, and reactive infiltrates are polytypic.

63534.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑明顯增厚、不規則吻合成網的骨硬化（osteosclerosis），中央骨小樑旁有一團緻密的梭形細胞結節性浸潤，與周圍脂肪性骨髓分界清楚，這種骨旁結節加上骨硬化是系統性肥大細胞增生症的線索；細胞核的細節在此倍率無法判讀。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with enclosed marrow spaces (osteosclerosis)
Compact paratrabecular/perivascular cellular nodule composed of spindled to oval cells in the center of the field
Surrounding marrow is largely fatty with reduced hematopoietic tissue
Scattered small cellular spaces within sclerotic bone containing fibrous stroma and cells
Magnification is too low to confirm elongated folded mast cell nuclei; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 IHC needed
63534.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine at low power shows marked osteosclerosis with thickened, irregular and anastomosing trabeculae enclosing small marrow spaces. A compact, well-demarcated nodular aggregate of spindled to oval cells lies adjacent to a trabecula in the center of the field, contrasting with the surrounding fatty marrow. Cytologic detail such as elongated folded nuclei and pale cytoplasm cannot be resolved at this magnification. The combination of a paratrabecular spindle-cell nodule and osteosclerosis is consistent with bone marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis; confirmation requires tryptase and CD117 immunostaining with aberrant CD25 expression and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with streaming hematopoiesis and reticulin fibrosis rather than compact tryptase-positive spindle-cell aggregates.
Benign lymphoid aggregates consist of small round lymphocytes rather than spindled cells with pale cytoplasm and are tryptase and CD25 negative.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial nests with desmoplasia that are keratin positive and tryptase negative.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with numerous large osteoclasts and fibrovascular marrow without a mast cell nodule.

63342.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的紅血球裡有細小、纖細的環狀體（ring form），可見點狀染色質，被感染的紅血球大小正常、沒有 Schüffner 小點，只見環狀體沒有其他階段，符合惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）滋養體。
features: Arrowed normal-sized red cells containing delicate small ring-form trophozoites with dot-like chromatin
Infected red cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner stippling
Only early ring stages seen; no mature trophozoites, schizonts or gametocytes in this field
Thick area of smear with overlapping red cells, limiting parasite detail
A small lymphocyte in the field
63342.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a relatively thick area with overlapping red cells. The arrowed red cells are normal in size and contain small, delicate ring-form trophozoites with punctate chromatin, without Schüffner stippling or pigment. No schizonts or gametocytes are identified in this field, and resolution limits assessment of parasite density. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum ring-form trophozoites; parasitemia should be quantified on a thin smear.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale infect enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and show amoeboid trophozoites and schizonts in peripheral blood.
Babesia shows pleomorphic rings, extracellular forms and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without pigment.

ddx.dx: Platelet overlying a red cell or stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Overlying platelets and precipitate lie in a different plane and lack the ring cytoplasm with a chromatin dot.
Howell-Jolly bodies are solid round dots and Pappenheimer bodies are clusters of granules, neither forming a ring.

63278.recognize_zh: BAL 抹片左側的巨噬細胞內塞滿大小不一、呈透明圓形或淡染的酵母菌體，周圍有未染色的空暈（莢膜），右側則是良性支氣管上皮細胞群；透明莢膜的圓形酵母菌被吞噬在巨噬細胞中是隱球菌（Cryptococcus）的線索。
features: Macrophage (left) with cytoplasm filled by numerous round, clear to pale, variably sized yeast forms surrounded by unstained halo-like capsules
Yeasts vary in size; occasional forms suggest budding, although detail is limited by focus
Cohesive sheet of benign bronchial epithelial cells with oval nuclei and fine chromatin (right)
Scattered inflammatory cells and mucoid/degenerated material in the background
Image is out of focus in places, limiting assessment of narrow-based budding
63278.describe_en: Bronchoalveolar lavage smear shows a cohesive group of benign bronchial epithelial cells and alveolar macrophages. One macrophage contains numerous round, variably sized yeast forms that appear clear or pale with surrounding unstained halos, consistent with capsules. Focus limits evaluation of budding morphology, but no pseudohyphae are identified and the epithelial cells lack malignant features. Findings are consistent with Cryptococcus species infection; confirmation with mucicarmine or India ink preparation, cryptococcal antigen testing, or culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller (2-4 um), uniform, with a pseudocapsule and no true mucicarmine-positive capsule, unlike the larger variably sized encapsulated yeasts here.
Blastomyces yeasts are larger (8-15 um) with thick double-contoured walls and broad-based budding, and lack a clear mucoid capsule.
Foamy macrophage vacuoles are empty, irregular and lack a central yeast body or budding, and are negative on mucicarmine/GMS.
The clinical mimic; malignant cells would show nuclear enlargement, prominent nucleoli and 3-D clusters, whereas the epithelial cells here are bland.

63214.recognize_zh: 厚片（thick smear）中紅血球已溶解，只剩淡色背景，散布許多帶紅紫色染色質點與不規則、破碎藍色胞質的阿米巴狀滋養體（trophozoite），部分周圍有淡粉紅點狀暈（Schüffner 點殘影）；兩顆白血球可作為大小參考。
features: Thick film with lysed red cells leaving a pale background with faint stippled erythrocyte ghosts
Numerous small parasites with 1-2 red chromatin dots and wispy, fragmented blue cytoplasm (amoeboid 'broken' trophozoites)
Several parasites surrounded by a pale pink stippled halo corresponding to Schüffner's dots in ghost red cells
One larger rounded parasite at upper right containing scattered golden-brown pigment (mature trophozoite or gametocyte)
Two leukocytes with lobulated nuclei for size reference
63214.describe_en: Giemsa-stained thick blood film shows lysed erythrocytes with numerous malaria parasites. Most are small trophozoites with one or two red chromatin dots and irregular, fragmented blue cytoplasm, several set within faint pink stippled halos of ghost red cells, suggestive of Schüffner's stippling. A larger rounded, pigment-containing parasite is present at the upper right, and two leukocytes are included for scale. Thick films are optimal for detecting parasites and estimating density, whereas species confirmation relies on the thin film (enlarged, stippled infected red cells). Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection.

ddx.vs: Falciparum thick films typically show only small compact rings with fine cytoplasm and banana-shaped gametocytes, without amoeboid trophozoites, stippled ghosts or pigmented mature asexual stages.
Ovale also shows Schüffner's stippling but has compact trophozoites; separation is best on thin film (oval, fimbriated infected cells) or by PCR.
Platelets and precipitate lack the combination of a discrete red chromatin dot with separate blue parasite cytoplasm.

63150.recognize_zh: 同一病人的血液在 37°C 下製作抹片時，紅血球分散均勻、沒有凝集團塊，與低溫下的大片凝集形成對比，表示凝集會隨加溫消失，是冷凝集素（cold agglutinin）的特徵。
features: Red cells evenly dispersed as single cells without agglutinates
Occasional small overlapping pairs only, without true clumping or rouleaux stacks
Red cells normocytic with preserved central pallor; rare crenated cell
Three segmented neutrophils with normal morphology
Adequate scattered platelets
63150.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear prepared from a sample maintained at 37 degrees C shows evenly dispersed red cells without agglutination. Red cell morphology is largely unremarkable with preserved central pallor and only occasional overlapping cells; segmented neutrophils and platelets appear normal. When compared with the smear prepared at low temperature, the disappearance of agglutinates on warming indicates a thermally reversible cold-reactive antibody. Findings are consistent with cold agglutinin-mediated red cell agglutination that resolves at body temperature.

ddx.vs: Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and agglutination or DAT IgG positivity that does not resolve on warming the sample to 37 degrees C.
Rouleaux form stacked linear chains that persist at 37 degrees C and disperse with saline, unlike cold agglutinates that dissolve on warming.
Morphology at 37 degrees C can appear normal, so the diagnosis depends on comparison with a cold smear and on DAT (C3d) and cold agglutinin titer.

63086.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中骨髓球、後骨髓球與帶狀核細胞的核內染色質凝集成粗大塊狀，細胞質顆粒明顯稀少；再加上核分葉不良（hypolobation），呈現 aCML 中「異常染色質凝集症候群」的樣貌。
features: Left-shifted granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin in large dark blocks
Hypogranular to agranular pale cytoplasm
Neutrophilic hypolobation (non-segmented, band-like nuclei)
Scattered small dark normoblasts and lymphocytes; platelets scarce
63086.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted granulopoiesis in which myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands have strikingly clumped, block-like nuclear chromatin and hypogranular cytoplasm. Hypolobated neutrophil forms are present, and platelets are scarce. Blasts are not increased in this field. The dysgranulopoietic features with abnormal chromatin clumping are suggestive of the syndrome of abnormal chromatin clumping, a variant of atypical CML (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia), pending exclusion of BCR::ABL1 and other defining alterations.

ddx.vs: MDS shows hypolobation with cytopenias but lacks the marked leukocytosis with left-shifted granulocytic expansion seen in aCML.
CML has basophilia and absence of dysplasia, and is BCR::ABL1-positive.
CNL shows mature, well-granulated neutrophils with minimal precursors and no dysgranulopoiesis.

63022.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量中至大型細胞，胞質豐富呈灰藍色、核偏心、部分可見核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），染色質較細緻，與旁邊的嗜中性球比較明顯較大；這些不成熟型態的漿細胞成群出現，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤（plasma cell myeloma）。
features: Numerous medium to large plasma cells occupying much of the field
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with eccentric round nuclei and focal perinuclear hof
Relatively fine to mildly clumped chromatin, suggesting immature (plasmablastic-leaning) forms
Variation in plasma cell size; occasional multinucleated or closely apposed nuclei
Scattered segmented neutrophils and bands for size comparison; red cells in background
63022.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain) shows a markedly increased population of plasma cells, many present in clusters. The plasma cells are medium to large, with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei, focal perinuclear clearing, and chromatin that is finer than that of mature plasma cells, with variation in cell size. Background granulocytes appear morphologically unremarkable. The photograph is taken through the eyepiece with some focus limitation, so nucleoli are not reliably assessed. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma in the context of a reported 60% marrow plasma cells and a monoclonal paraprotein.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, with clock-face chromatin, usually below 10% and polytypic on light chain studies, rather than sheets of large immature forms.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has larger blasts with central prominent nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, typically extramedullary, often EBER-positive and in immunocompromised patients.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, not a monomorphous plasma cell population.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm with vacuoles without a hof, and are nonspecific esterase-positive and CD138-negative.

62958.recognize_zh: 觸片（touch imprint）上是一大片單一形態的中至大型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質細緻分散、部分可見小核仁、細胞質極少，呈母細胞樣（blastoid）外觀，需與淋巴母細胞及大 B 細胞淋巴瘤區分。
features: Monotonous population of intermediate-to-large discohesive lymphoid cells
High N:C ratio with scant pale basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed, blastoid-appearing chromatin
Small nucleoli visible in a subset of cells
Occasional larger cells and crushed nuclear streaks; few small mature lymphocytes in background
62958.describe_en: Touch imprint shows a cellular, monotonous population of discohesive intermediate-to-large lymphoid cells with high N:C ratios and scant pale cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to slightly irregular with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli in some cells, imparting a blastoid appearance. Few small mature lymphocytes are present and there are crush artifacts. In the context of cyclin D1 and CD5 expression, findings are suggestive of mantle cell lymphoma with blastoid features.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts look similar on imprint but are TdT+ and cyclin D1-, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT- with cyclin D1 and SOX11 expression.
DLBCL cells are usually larger with more cytoplasm and prominent or multiple nucleoli, and are cyclin D1- in almost all cases.
Myeloid blasts may show granules or Auer rods and are MPO/CD34/CD117 positive, lacking B-cell markers and cyclin D1.

62894.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色下，背景大多數小淋巴球與組織球為陰性，只有少數散在的大細胞呈膜狀加上核旁高基氏體點狀（Golgi dot）棕色染色，這是 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞的典型 CD30 染色型態。
features: Scattered isolated large cells with membranous and paranuclear (Golgi) dot-like brown staining for CD30
Positive cells are sparse and individually dispersed, not in sheets
Background small lymphocytes and histiocytes negative
A few cells show weak, granular cytoplasmic staining
Multinucleated polykaryocytes in the background are not highlighted
62894.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 on the lymph node shows a predominantly negative background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes. Scattered, individually dispersed large cells show membranous and paranuclear Golgi-pattern positivity, with a few cells showing weaker cytoplasmic staining. The multinucleated Warthin-Finkeldey-like cells are not highlighted. This staining pattern supports Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells and is consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, to be interpreted with CD15, PAX5, and CD45 results.

ddx.vs: Activated immunoblasts are CD30 positive but lack typical Reed-Sternberg morphology, are CD45+ with strong PAX5/CD20, and are CD15 negative.
Shows strong, uniform CD30 staining in cohesive sheets or sinusoidal clusters, often ALK positive, rather than rare scattered cells.
Warthin-Finkeldey polykaryocytes are CD30 negative and there are no CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells.

62830.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆中型母細胞，箭頭所指的細胞核內有一塊邊界清楚的淡染凹陷（cup-like invagination），看起來像大核仁，這是杯狀母細胞（cup-like blasts）的典型外觀。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Cup-like nuclear invagination: a sharply demarcated pale zone occupying part of the nucleus (arrows), mimicking a large nucleolus
Finely dispersed chromatin; no distinct Auer rods visible
Several smudged/disrupted leukocytes in the field
Background red cells without striking poikilocytosis; platelets sparse
62830.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Several blasts display a well-demarcated pale nuclear invagination (cup-like morphology, arrows) that can be mistaken for a prominent nucleolus. Auer rods are not identified in this field, and a few smudged cells are present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts; correlation with NPM1 and FLT3-ITD testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL cells have bilobed/folded 'butterfly' nuclei and often Auer rod bundles, whereas cup-like blasts have round nuclei with a single punched-out invagination.
Lymphoblasts lack the cup-like invagination and myeloid features; distinction requires MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry.
A true nucleolus is small and well-circumscribed within chromatin, whereas the cup-like invagination is a larger pale area indenting the nuclear contour and occupying up to a quarter of the nucleus.

62766.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中的肉芽腫中央是一個圓形透明脂肪空泡，外圍環繞一圈嗜伊紅纖維素樣環，再往外是上皮樣組織球與發炎細胞，形成「甜甜圈狀」纖維素環肉芽腫（fibrin-ring granuloma），在發燒待查的旅遊者應優先想到 Q 熱（Coxiella burnetii）。
features: Cellular marrow with a focal granulomatous lesion adjacent to bone trabeculae (low power)
Granuloma with a central clear lipid vacuole (doughnut configuration)
Thin eosinophilic fibrinoid ring encircling the central vacuole
Surrounding epithelioid histiocytes, neutrophils, and lymphocytes; no caseous necrosis
Immunostain (antibody not labeled) highlights the ring and the surrounding histiocytic rim
62766.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow containing a focal granulomatous lesion. At high power, the granuloma consists of a central clear lipid vacuole encircled by a thin eosinophilic fibrinoid ring, surrounded in turn by epithelioid histiocytes admixed with neutrophils and lymphocytes, without caseous necrosis. An immunostain, whose antibody is not labeled in the image, highlights the ring and the surrounding histiocytic cuff. Findings are consistent with fibrin-ring (doughnut) granulomas; in a returning traveler with fever of unknown origin, Coxiella burnetii (Q fever) serology and PCR are recommended.

ddx.dx: Fibrin-ring granulomas of other causes (EBV, CMV, leishmaniasis, Hodgkin lymphoma, allopurinol hypersensitivity)
ddx.vs: The ring granuloma morphology is shared, so these are separated by serology, organism stains, drug history, and absence of Reed-Sternberg cells rather than by the granuloma itself.
Tuberculous granulomas show caseous necrosis with Langhans giant cells and acid-fast bacilli, lacking a central fat vacuole with a fibrin ring.
Lipogranulomas contain lipid vacuoles surrounded by lipid-laden macrophages and lymphocytes but lack the concentric eosinophilic fibrin ring and associated neutrophils.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, non-necrotizing epithelioid aggregates with giant cells and no central vacuole or fibrin ring.

62702.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD56 對 CD57 四象限流式圖：CD57+CD56+ 占 41.22%，綠色 NK 細胞緊密成團、CD57 強而 CD56 僅弱到中度；CD56 並非強陽性，較符合成熟 NK 細胞的慢性增生。
features: Quadrant dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD56-APC (x) versus CD57-FITC (y)
CD57+CD56+ quadrant 41.22%, dominated by a tight green NK-cell cluster
NK cluster CD57 bright (~10^1.5 to 10^2) with dim-to-moderate CD56 (not CD56 bright)
CD57-CD56- quadrant ~48% (T and B cells), CD57+CD56- 6.43%, CD57-CD56+ 4.34%
Uniform phenotype of the expanded cluster suggests a restricted mature NK subset
62702.describe_en: Flow cytometric quadrant plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD56 versus CD57. CD56-positive, CD57-positive cells account for 41.22% of lymphocytes and form a tight cluster with bright CD57 and dim-to-moderate CD56, while CD56-positive CD57-negative cells are only 4.34%. The homogeneous CD56-dim, CD57-bright phenotype corresponds to mature cytotoxic NK cells rather than CD56-bright immature NK cells. Findings are consistent with the reported chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: ANKL cells are typically CD56 bright and CD57 negative, unlike this CD56-dim, CD57-bright cluster.
T-LGL cells may be CD57 positive and CD56 variable but express surface CD3, which must be excluded on other tubes.
Reactive NK cells show more heterogeneous CD57/CD56 and polyclonal KIR expression, with a transient course.

62638.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中以紅血球前驅細胞為主：核圓、染色質顆粒狀、細胞質深藍色的前紅血球母細胞與嗜鹼性正母紅血球成群出現，呈紅血球系增生，為 PNH 溶血的非特異性骨髓表現。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by erythroid precursors at all stages
Pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts: round nuclei, coarse-granular chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Polychromatophilic normoblasts with grey-blue cytoplasm and condensing chromatin
Occasional granulocytic precursor with granules and a band/segmented neutrophil; granulocytes relatively reduced
Several smudged/crushed nuclei; no obvious significant dyserythropoiesis or blast excess in this field
62638.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a cellular specimen with prominent erythroid hyperplasia, including numerous pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, together with more mature polychromatophilic forms. Erythroid maturation is orderly and overt dysplasia is not evident in this field; granulocytic precursors are relatively decreased. Findings are consistent with a reactive erythroid hyperplasia in the setting of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; the diagnosis rests on flow cytometry for GPI-anchored proteins.

ddx.vs: MDS shows significant dyserythropoiesis (nuclear budding, multinucleation, ring sideroblasts) and dysgranulopoiesis, which are not evident here.
Megaloblastic precursors have open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant bands/metamyelocytes.
Parvovirus shows a few giant pronormoblasts with nuclear inclusions and absent later erythroid stages, not a full maturation spectrum.

62574.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E：淋巴結整體結構保留，被膜與竇下方可見一個濾泡，其生發中心被淡染的大細胞群部分取代，周圍仍有深色小淋巴球構成的外套區；大細胞聚集侷限於濾泡內而非瀰漫破壞結構，是 germinotropic LPD 的低倍線索。
features: Preserved lymph node architecture with capsule and patent subcapsular region
Follicle whose germinal center is partially replaced by aggregates of large pale cells
Rim of dark small lymphocytes (mantle zone) around the involved follicle
Paracortex with prominent high endothelial venules
No diffuse effacement or geographic necrosis at this magnification
62574.describe_en: Lymph node at low power shows a preserved architecture with an intact capsule. A follicle beneath the capsule contains a germinal center that is partially replaced by aggregates of large pale-staining cells, surrounded by a rim of dark small mantle zone lymphocytes, while the adjacent paracortex shows prominent high endothelial venules. There is no diffuse effacement or necrosis. The germinal-center-restricted clusters of large cells, confirmed as HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER positive plasmablasts on ancillary studies, are consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarization with tingible body macrophages and a mix of centroblasts and centrocytes, and lack HHV8/EBV-positive plasmablast clusters.
MCD shows regressed, hyalinized germinal centers with expanded onion-skin mantle zones and scattered single plasmablasts rather than germinal-center aggregates.
FL shows crowded back-to-back monotonous follicles lacking mantle zones and polarity, with BCL2+ germinal-center B cells rather than CD20-negative plasmablasts.

62510.recognize_zh: CD19+ B 細胞門內的 CD5 對 CD23 流式圖：幾乎所有 B 細胞呈單一族群，CD5 弱陽性（約 10^3），CD23 陽性且強度分布廣，兩者共同表現（CD5+/CD23+）是 CLL 最典型的免疫表型。
features: Dot plot gated on CD19+ B cells: CD5-PB (x-axis) versus CD23-APC700 (y-axis)
Single dominant B-cell population coexpressing CD5 and CD23
Dim CD5 intensity (~10^3), lower than expected for T cells
CD23 positive with a broad intensity range (~10^3 to 10^5)
No separate CD5-negative/CD23-negative normal B-cell population
62510.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot gated on CD19-positive B cells shows a single dominant population coexpressing dim CD5 and CD23, with CD23 intensity spanning a broad range. No distinct CD5-negative normal B-cell population is identified. CD5/CD23 coexpression in a monotypic B-cell population is the characteristic immunophenotype of chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and a Matutes score using CD5, CD23, FMC7, CD79b, and sIg intensity supports the diagnosis. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: MCL is CD5-positive but characteristically CD23-negative or dim, with brighter CD20/sIg and cyclin D1 expression.

ddx.dx: CD5-negative small B-cell lymphomas (MZL, FL, LPL)
ddx.vs: These lack CD5 coexpression on the clonal B cells.
Trisomy 12 CLL remains CD5/CD23-positive but more often shows brighter CD20, sIg, and FMC7, which may lower the Matutes score.

62446.recognize_zh: 大腸固有層表皮下方一片卵圓至梭形細胞呈 CD25 陽性（棕色膜/細胞質染色），分布呈帶狀；CD25 在異常（腫瘤性）肥大細胞表現，正常肥大細胞不表現，是系統性肥大細胞增生症的診斷次要準則之一。
features: Colonic mucosa with intact crypts at higher magnification
Band-like subepithelial infiltrate of oval to spindle-shaped cells in the lamina propria
Infiltrating cells show diffuse granular membranous/cytoplasmic CD25 positivity
Crypt epithelium shows weak nonspecific apical cytoplasmic staining (background)
Deeper lamina propria contains mostly CD25-negative inflammatory cells with rare positive cells
62446.describe_en: CD25 immunostain of colonic mucosa shows a band-like subepithelial infiltrate of oval to spindled cells in the superficial lamina propria that are uniformly positive for CD25. The crypts are preserved and show only weak nonspecific epithelial staining, and the deeper lamina propria contains mostly CD25-negative cells. In the context of a CD117/tryptase-positive infiltrate, aberrant CD25 expression by mast cells supports a neoplastic mast cell proliferation; findings are consistent with mastocytosis involving the colon.

ddx.vs: Non-neoplastic mast cells are CD25-negative and do not form spindled sheets or aggregates.

ddx.dx: Activated T-cell infiltrate or adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
ddx.vs: CD25-positive T cells are round lymphoid cells that co-express CD3 and lack CD117/tryptase, unlike spindled mast cells.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei with eosinophils but are CD1a/langerin/S100-positive and CD25-negative.
Bland spindle cell proliferations in the lamina propria are EMA/claudin-1 or S100-positive and negative for CD25 and CD117.

62382.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見大小不一的紅血球：部分為較小、中央淡染的低色素細胞，部分為較大、色澤飽滿的細胞，另見少數淚滴狀與拉長的紅血球；兩群紅血球並存（dimorphic）是缺鐵性貧血接受鐵劑治療後的常見表現，大量鋸齒狀細胞則多為製片假影。
features: Marked anisocytosis with coexisting smaller hypochromic and larger normochromic red cells
Occasional teardrop and elongated/pencil-like cells
Many crenated red cells (echinocytes), consistent with preparation artifact
Small platelets and a few platelet clumps in background
No nucleated red cells, basophilic stippling or leukocytes in this field
62382.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with two red cell populations: smaller hypochromic cells with widened central pallor and larger, well-hemoglobinized cells. Occasional teardrop and elongated forms are present, and many cells are crenated, most likely due to a slide preparation artifact. Platelets are present with small clumps. No nucleated red cells or basophilic stippling are identified in this field. In a patient receiving iron supplementation, the findings are consistent with a dimorphic red cell picture of treated iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Sideroblastic anemia shows dimorphic cells with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts, and ferritin is high rather than low.
Transfused normocytic cells mimic a dimorphic smear and are identified by clinical history.
MDS shows dimorphic red cells with dysplastic neutrophils (hypogranulation, pseudo-Pelger) and cytopenias in other lineages.

62318.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一大團黏聚的小圓形腫瘤細胞，細胞沿放射狀排列，圍繞中央一團淡藍紫色纖維狀的神經纖維網（neuropil），形成 Homer Wright 玫瑰花結（rosette），是神經母細胞瘤轉移的特徵。
features: Large cohesive aggregate of small round tumor cells arranged radially around a central core
Central pale fibrillary neuropil-like material with no lumen, forming a Homer Wright rosette
Tumor cells with high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm and round hyperchromatic nuclei
Surrounding dispersed tumor cells and residual hematopoietic cells, with streaks of blood/plasma in background
Scale bar 100 um indicates a low-power view; fine chromatin detail is not assessable
62318.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a large cohesive aggregate of small round cells with scant cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei arranged radially around a central core of pale fibrillary neuropil-like material, forming a Homer Wright rosette. Numerous similar cells are dispersed around the aggregate, with few residual hematopoietic elements. Fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. In an infant with a suprarenal mass, findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by metastatic neuroblastoma, supported by synaptophysin, chromogranin and CD56 positivity on the biopsy.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts are discohesive single cells without rosettes or neuropil, and are TdT/CD19/CD34-positive and synaptophysin-negative.
Ewing sarcoma may form rare rosettes but lacks prominent neuropil, and shows membranous CD99, NKX2.2 and EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells can cluster and mimic leukemia but have vacuolated cytoplasm, lack neuropil rosettes and are desmin/myogenin-positive.
These may form rosettes too (Flexner-Wintersteiner or Homer Wright), and separation requires clinical primary site and PHOX2B/ancillary studies rather than aspirate morphology.

62126.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 中央為上皮樣組織球與多核巨細胞圍繞一團亮紅色、呈結晶狀至無定形的嗜酸性物質，外圍為小淋巴球，屬 Kimura 病中可見的肉芽腫反應。
features: Central aggregate of bright eosinophilic crystal-like to amorphous material
Surrounding palisade of epithelioid histiocytes with oval vesicular nuclei
Multinucleated giant cells at the edge of the eosinophilic material
Outer rim of small mature lymphocytes and scattered plasma cells
No necrotizing caseation or atypical large cells in this field
62126.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a granuloma composed of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells surrounding a central aggregate of bright eosinophilic, crystal-like to amorphous material. The granuloma is surrounded by small mature lymphocytes and scattered plasma cells, without caseous necrosis or atypical cells in this field. The eosinophilic material is suggestive of degranulated eosinophil products such as Charcot-Leyden crystals. In the context of eosinophilic microabscesses and follicular changes elsewhere, the findings are consistent with Kimura disease.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas often show caseous necrosis with organisms on AFB/GMS stains rather than eosinophilic crystalline debris.
Parasitic infection may show eosinophil-rich granulomas but contains identifiable parasite fragments with a matching exposure history.
LCH shows sinusoidal grooved Langerhans cells that are CD1a/langerin positive with eosinophils, rather than epithelioid granulomas.
EGPA shows necrotizing vasculitis with extravascular granulomas, asthma and ANCA positivity rather than node-restricted follicular hyperplasia.

62062.recognize_zh: 低倍下組織碎片左側為密集的淋巴漿細胞浸潤，右側則逐漸轉為粉紅色膠原纖維與梭形細胞構成的纖維化區域，呈現發炎細胞浸潤合併明顯硬化（sclerosis）的反應性淋巴結型態。
features: Fragment of lymphoid tissue with a dense mononuclear inflammatory infiltrate on the left
Sharp transition to a sclerotic zone of pink collagen with streaming spindle fibroblasts on the right
Infiltrating lymphocytes and plasma cells extending into the fibrous tissue
Scattered vessels and paler histiocyte-rich areas; no discrete follicles visible in this fragment
Small, bland nuclei without sheets of large atypical cells at this magnification
62062.describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows a fragment of lymphoid tissue containing a dense, predominantly small mononuclear infiltrate that transitions to a sclerotic zone of collagen with streaming spindle cells, likely representing capsular or perinodal fibrosis. Inflammatory cells, including lymphocytes and plasma cells, extend into the fibrous stroma. Lymphoid follicles are not well seen in this fragment and there are no sheets of atypical large cells at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphadenitis with sclerosis and plasmacytosis; in the appropriate clinical context syphilitic lymphadenitis should be excluded with Treponema immunostain and serology.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis type
ddx.vs: NSCHL shows broad birefringent collagen bands encircling nodules that contain lacunar Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+, CD15+), which are not evident here.
IgG4-related disease shows storiform fibrosis with abundant IgG4+ plasma cells and obliterative phlebitis, requiring IgG4/IgG immunostains to separate from syphilis.

ddx.dx: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor / inflammatory pseudotumor of lymph node
ddx.vs: Inflammatory pseudotumor centers on the hilum and trabeculae with a spindle-cell proliferation expanding the node, and syphilis must be excluded by Treponema staining.

61998.recognize_zh: 整片密集排列的圓形細胞幾乎全部呈清楚的細胞膜（環狀）棕色染色，腫瘤細胞呈片狀取代組織；標記名稱未標示，依病例脈絡應為漿細胞標記（如 CD138），或 t(11;14) 骨髓瘤常見的 CD20。
features: Diffuse sheet of densely packed, uniform round cells
Strong, crisp membranous (ring-like) staining in virtually all cells
Nuclei unstained and centrally to eccentrically placed within the stained membrane rings
Rare unstained structures (e.g., a small vessel/stromal space) interrupt the sheet
No residual unstained hematopoietic population visible in this field
Marker not labeled; interpretation relies on case context
61998.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled on the image) shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of uniform round cells with strong membranous staining in essentially all cells, replacing the normal architecture in this field. Only scattered unstained stromal elements are present. In the context of this case, the pattern is compatible with a membranous marker such as CD138 (plasma cells) or aberrant CD20, which is enriched in myeloma with t(11;14). Findings support extensive involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm; the specific marker should be confirmed from the source case.
