ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli and are CD138-negative with PAX5 positivity, whereas myeloma cells are CD138+ with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction and usually PAX5-negative.

Plasmablastic lymphoma also expresses CD138 but shows immunoblastic morphology, very high Ki-67, frequent EBER positivity and MYC rearrangement, typically in extramedullary sites of immunocompromised patients.
Carcinoma can be CD138+ but forms cohesive nests and is cytokeratin-positive and light-chain negative.

61998.stain: IHC: membranous marker, unlabeled (likely CD138 or CD20)

61806.recognize_zh: 這是 CD45 對側向散射（SSC）的流式細胞儀圖（非形態圖）：CD45 弱陽性、低 SSC 的母細胞區占 85.22%，顆粒球 6.75%、淋巴球 4.22%，單核球僅 0.07%，顯示母細胞大量增加且幾乎沒有單核球。
features: Flow cytometry plot of live events: CD45-KO (x-axis) versus side scatter (y-axis)
Dominant CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast gate comprising 85.22% of events
Granulocytes 6.75% with high side scatter
Lymphocytes 4.22% in the CD45-bright low side-scatter region
Monocytes nearly absent at 0.07%
61806.describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side-scatter analysis of live events shows a dominant CD45-dim, low side-scatter population in the blast gate accounting for 85.22% of events, with residual granulocytes (6.75%) and lymphocytes (4.22%). The monocyte gate contains only 0.07% of events. The marked expansion of the blast region supports acute leukemia, requiring lineage assignment with a full antibody panel. Profound monocytopenia is a characteristic feature of GATA2 deficiency, although in this sample it is also influenced by leukemic replacement.

61742.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交在粉紅色背景中，深藍黑色的陽性細胞核圍繞著中央一條血管排列成環狀，部分侵入管壁；EBV 陽性細胞呈血管中心性分布，是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的特徵。
features: Dark blue-black EBER-positive nuclei on a pink counterstain
Positive cells concentrated in a ring around and within the wall of a central vessel (angiocentric)
EBER-positive nuclei of small to intermediate size, some larger and irregular
Surrounding tissue shows vacuolated, necrotic-appearing background with fewer positive cells
61742.describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBER shows numerous positive nuclei clustered around and within the wall of a central blood vessel, producing an angiocentric distribution. Positive cells range from small to larger atypical forms, while the surrounding vacuolated, necrotic-appearing tissue contains fewer positive cells. The perivascular concentration of EBV-infected cells is consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, with the B-cell phenotype of positive cells to be confirmed by CD20.

ddx.vs: ENKTL also shows angiocentric EBER-positive cells, but they are CD56- and cytoplasmic CD3-positive and CD20-negative.
PTLD occurs in transplant recipients and usually forms mass lesions or sheets without the characteristic pulmonary angiodestructive pattern.
GPA vasculitis lacks EBER-positive lymphoid cells and features neutrophils, microabscesses, and palisading granulomas.

61678.recognize_zh: 三顆中等大小的淋巴樣細胞聚在一起，核不規則、有凹陷，染色質中度濃縮，細胞質深藍且邊緣有明顯的小泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），這種嗜鹼性、帶突起的細胞質是 T-PLL 細胞常見的特徵。
features: Cluster of three medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small mature lymphocytes
Moderate to high N:C ratio with irregular, indented to slightly lobulated nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli are not conspicuous at this magnification
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
Background red cells with some elongated and teardrop-like shapes, likely partly smear-related
61678.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cluster of three medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have irregular, indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs. No cytoplasmic granules are seen. In the context of a lymphocytosis, these features are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia (small-cell/irregular nuclear variant morphology), pending immunophenotypic and TCL1A rearrangement confirmation.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells show cerebriform nuclei with fine linear grooves and scant pale cytoplasm, and are typically CD7 and CD26 negative, whereas T-PLL cells have basophilic blebbed cytoplasm and are CD7 bright.
ATLL cells have markedly polylobated 'flower' nuclei and are CD25 bright with HTLV-1 serology positive, unlike the less lobated nuclei here.
CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm and coarse 'soccer-ball' chromatin, lack cytoplasmic basophilia and blebs, and express CD19/CD23.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules and round nuclei, unlike the agranular basophilic blebbed cytoplasm here.

61614.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑旁與脂肪間大片均一的中型細胞，核卵圓、染色質細緻，正常成熟細胞與巨核細胞明顯減少，並散見含鐵血黃素，符合 AML 的芽細胞瀰漫浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized immature cells
Oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; moderate pale cytoplasm
Marked reduction of maturing myeloid, erythroid, and megakaryocytic elements (rare megakaryocyte)
Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Residual fat spaces and an intact bony trabecula
61614.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows a hypercellular marrow diffusely infiltrated by sheets of monotonous, medium-sized immature cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced, with only rare megakaryocytes and scattered maturing cells. Hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; CD34/CD117 immunohistochemistry and molecular testing are required for subclassification as AML with mutated CEBPA.

ddx.vs: ALL may form similar sheets; TdT, PAX5/CD19, CD3, and MPO immunostains are needed to establish lineage.
Myeloma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, and are CD138-positive with light-chain restriction.
Metastatic tumors form cohesive nests with stromal reaction and are CD45-negative with lineage-specific markers.

61550.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下正中央一顆大型雙核細胞，兩個核呈鏡像排列、各有大而嗜酸性的核仁，胞質豐富淡染，即典型 Reed-Sternberg 細胞；背景有嗜酸性球、小淋巴球、組織球與纖維化，符合 CHL 骨髓侵犯。
features: Classic binucleate Reed-Sternberg cell with mirror-image nuclear lobes and abundant pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Each lobe has vesicular chromatin and a prominent eosinophilic, inclusion-like nucleolus
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, histiocytes and plump fibroblasts
Loose fibrillary/edematous stroma replacing normal hematopoiesis in this field
61550.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow biopsy shows a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, histiocytes and fibroblasts in a loose fibrotic stroma, without normal hematopoietic elements. A diagnostic binucleate Reed-Sternberg cell is present, with mirror-image nuclei, vesicular chromatin, large eosinophilic nucleoli and abundant pale cytoplasm. With CD30+, CD15+, weak PAX5+, CD20− and EBER+ large cells, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by EBV-positive classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have multilobated, hyperchromatic nuclei without large inclusion-like nucleoli and granular cytoplasm, and lack the mirror-image binucleation of an RS cell.

ddx.dx: Reed-Sternberg-like immunoblasts in infectious mononucleosis or drug reactions
ddx.vs: RS-like cells in reactive states are CD20+, CD45+ and CD15−, sit in a background of activated lymphocytes rather than fibrosis with eosinophils.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or PTCL with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: These show atypical T cells and are PAX5-negative (ALCL) or have a clonal T-cell background, requiring immunophenotyping.

61486.recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞內吞噬了數個有核細胞（分葉或腎形核），細胞質中又散布大量約 2–3 µm 的小圓形紫色小體（LD 小體，Leishman-Donovan bodies），同時呈現噬血現象與利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體。
features: Large macrophage containing several engulfed nucleated cells (band/segmented granulocytes and other hematopoietic cells), indicating hemophagocytosis
Numerous small (about 2-3 um) round-to-oval dark purple bodies scattered in the macrophage cytoplasm and at its periphery
Tiny bodies consistent with amastigotes; nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast not clearly resolved at this magnification
Adjacent intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with fine chromatin and occasional myeloid precursors
Aspirate background with red cells; free extracellular amastigotes are possible along the cell edge
61486.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage that has engulfed several nucleated hematopoietic cells, including granulocytes, consistent with hemophagocytosis. The macrophage cytoplasm contains numerous small, round-to-oval, dark-staining bodies approximately 2-3 um in size, consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies (amastigotes), although the kinetoplast is not clearly resolved at this magnification. Surrounding marrow cells include myeloid precursors and mononuclear cells. In a child with fever, massive splenomegaly and pancytopenia, findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis with secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo and budding and lack the rod-shaped kinetoplast of Leishmania amastigotes.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and no kinetoplast.
Superimposed platelets are larger, granular and lie out of the plane, whereas amastigotes are uniform, intracellular and have a nucleus plus kinetoplast.

ddx.dx: Primary (familial) HLH or other infection-associated HLH
ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis alone is nonspecific; demonstration of intracellular amastigotes (or rK39 serology/PCR) identifies Leishmania as the trigger.

61422.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆破裂巨噬細胞周圍散布大量均一的小型卵圓形紫色小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），旁邊為一顆嗜酸性顆粒細胞作對照，符合利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體。
features: Central macrophage nucleus surrounded by a halo of numerous tiny oval purple amastigotes in pale, partly disrupted cytoplasm
Organisms uniform in size (smaller than a platelet-sized dot to about 3 um), individually discrete
Kinetoplast not clearly resolved at this magnification
Adjacent cell with coarse orange-pink granules (eosinophil precursor) for size comparison
Background of mixed myeloid, erythroid and lymphoid marrow elements
61422.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with pale, partly disrupted cytoplasm containing and surrounded by numerous small, uniform, oval basophilic bodies. The surrounding hematopoietic cells include maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and an eosinophilic precursor. A distinct kinetoplast is not well resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies) in a patient with visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo and no kinetoplast and are GMS-positive, while Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus bar-shaped kinetoplast.
Talaromyces forms elongated yeasts with central septation from binary fission, lacking a kinetoplast.
T. cruzi amastigotes are morphologically similar but reside mainly in cardiac/smooth muscle rather than marrow macrophages; geography and serology/PCR separate them.
Released granules are smaller, irregular and lack the uniform oval shape with internal nucleus-kinetoplast structure.

61358.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球比一般小淋巴球大，細胞質豐富淡藍，內含散在的粗大嗜天青顆粒，核圓至略凹、染色質濃縮，是典型的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Medium to large lymphocyte, roughly twice the diameter of an erythrocyte
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm with low N:C ratio
Scattered coarse azurophilic (red-purple) cytoplasmic granules
Round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleolus
Background erythrocytes and platelets unremarkable
61358.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granular lymphocyte with a round to slightly indented nucleus, condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing scattered coarse azurophilic granules. Red cells and platelets in the field are unremarkable. A single cell is morphologically consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; distinction between a reactive expansion and T-cell or NK-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia requires absolute LGL counts, flow cytometry and T-cell receptor clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and often lack distinct azurophilic granules.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles rather than a few coarse granules.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections, oval to bean-shaped nuclei with spongy chromatin and no azurophilic granules.
Granulocytic precursors have more numerous granules, a Golgi hof and less condensed chromatin with nucleoli.

61294.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度很高，中央一群紅血球前驅細胞緊密成團：核圓、深染、核周有清楚的透亮暈，並可見分裂相；周圍背景充滿帶紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球與分葉粒細胞。成片紅系前驅細胞群加上嗜酸性球增多，是 PCM1::JAK2 骨髓/淋巴腫瘤的特徵組合。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a large, cohesive cluster of intermediate erythroid precursors in the center
Erythroid precursors have round, centrally placed, hyperchromatic nuclei with a crisp perinuclear clear halo and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Several mitotic figures within the erythroid cluster
Background of numerous eosinophils with bright red granules and abundant maturing segmented granulocytes
Scattered brown-golden pigment (hemosiderin); megakaryocytes not prominent in this field
61294.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular with a prominent, expanded cluster of intermediate-stage erythroid precursors showing round hyperchromatic nuclei, perinuclear clearing and scattered mitoses. The surrounding marrow shows granulocytic proliferation with numerous eosinophils and maturing neutrophils, and scattered hemosiderin pigment. Blasts are not obviously increased in this field. In the appropriate context, large clusters of erythroid precursors with eosinophilia are a characteristic finding. Findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PCM1::JAK2 fusion, which requires cytogenetic or molecular confirmation of t(8;9)(p22;p24.1).

ddx.dx: Chronic eosinophilic leukemia or myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Share eosinophilia but lack the conspicuous large erythroid clusters; separated by FISH or RT-PCR for the specific fusion.
MPNs show atypical clustered megakaryocytes and fibrosis rather than dominant erythroid islands, and carry JAK2 V617F/CALR/MPL mutations instead of a JAK2 fusion.

ddx.dx: Acute erythroid leukemia or MDS with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: Show proerythroblast predominance and dyserythropoiesis, usually TP53-mutated and without eosinophilia.
Erythroid islands are normally orderly and paratrabecular-sparing without associated eosinophilia or a clonal fusion.

61230.recognize_zh: 淋巴結觸片（Diff-Quik 類染色）中大量小淋巴球背景下散布許多大型組織球，細胞質淡藍豐富，內部包含數顆完整的淋巴球（emperipolesis），是 Rosai-Dorfman 病在細胞學上的關鍵線索。
features: Highly cellular touch preparation dominated by small round lymphocytes with a polymorphous mixture of cell sizes
Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Intact small lymphocytes enclosed within histiocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis), several per cell
Histiocyte nuclei round to oval, pale and vesicular, partially obscured by engulfed cells
Scattered clear vacuoles/lipid droplets in the background; no cohesive epithelial clusters
61230.describe_en: Touch preparation of lymph node (Romanowsky-type stain) shows a cellular smear composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with admixed larger lymphoid cells. Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm are distributed throughout, many containing multiple intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, consistent with emperipolesis. There are no cohesive tumor clusters or Reed-Sternberg-like cells. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease, to be confirmed on tissue with S100-positive, CD1a-negative histiocytes.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophages in reactive follicular hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact viable lymphocytes and are S100 negative.
Macrophages ingest red cells, platelets and nuclear debris that are being digested, rather than intact lymphocytes in clear vacuoles.
Cytology shows grooved, folded nuclei and eosinophils without emperipolesis, with CD1a/langerin positivity.

61166.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中可見右側一團深染的骨髓顆粒（marrow particle）及左側拖曳的細胞帶；在此放大倍率下無法清楚分辨纏繞於顆粒內的微絲蟲，需高倍確認。
features: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear through an eyepiece
Dense, deeply basophilic marrow particle with fat vacuoles at the right
Cellular trails streaming away from the particle toward the left
A microfilaria is not distinctly resolved within the particle at this magnification
61166.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular marrow particle containing fat vacuoles and cellular trails extending from it. At this magnification and image quality, the microfilaria described as entangled within the particle cannot be distinctly identified; high-power examination of the particle edges is required. In the stated clinical context of pancytopenia with microfilariae seen in blood and marrow, the image documents the particle in which the parasite was found, but it is not independently diagnostic of filariasis.

ddx.dx: Fibrin strands or stromal fibers within a particle
ddx.vs: Fibrin and stroma lack the organized body with column of somatic nuclei and tapering tail seen in a microfilaria at high power.
Only a high-power search showing a sheathed or unsheathed larva with nuclei confirms microfilaria; low power cannot separate them.

61102.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見多顆較小、深染且無中央淡染區的球形紅血球（spherocytes），夾雜體積較大、偏藍的多染性紅血球（A）；超活體染色顯示大量含網狀沉澱物的網狀紅血球（B），呈現溶血伴骨髓代償反應。
features: Numerous spherocytes: small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor
Anisocytosis with larger polychromatophilic (bluish-gray) red cells
Occasional red cells with retained central pallor; no significant schistocytes or agglutinates in this field
Single neutrophil with normal segmentation
Supravital stain shows markedly increased reticulocytes with blue-staining reticular RNA precipitates
61102.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous spherocytes with loss of central pallor, anisocytosis and polychromasia; schistocytes and red cell agglutination are not evident in this field. White cell morphology in the visible neutrophil is unremarkable. A supravital (new methylene blue) preparation shows a markedly increased proportion of reticulocytes containing precipitated reticular material. The findings indicate spherocytic hemolysis with a brisk marrow response; together with a positive direct antiglobulin test, they are consistent with autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: HS shows identical spherocytes but has a negative DAT, family history and abnormal EMA-binding flow cytometry, so morphology alone cannot separate it from warm AIHA.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet cells, triangles) with thrombocytopenia rather than predominantly round spherocytes.
Clostridial toxin and thermal injury produce microspherocytes with fragments and budding (and in sepsis, ghost cells) in the appropriate clinical setting.
CAD shows red cell agglutinates in clumps on the smear and a C3d-only DAT, with fewer spherocytes than warm IgG AIHA.

61038.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交在淡紅色複染的淋巴結背景中，只有少數散在的小型與較大型淋巴細胞核呈深藍黑色陽性訊號，沒有成片陽性，這種散在 EBV 陽性 B 細胞是 AITL 常見的伴隨現象。
features: EBER in situ hybridization with pale red nuclear counterstain
Scattered individual cells with strong dark blue nuclear EBER signal
Positive cells range from small lymphocytes to a larger cell with lobulated nucleus (lower left)
Positive cells are sparse and non-clustered; the vast majority of nuclei are negative
Faint weakly positive nuclei scattered among strongly positive cells
61038.describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded RNA (EBER) on a lymph node section shows scattered small and occasional larger lymphoid cells with strong nuclear signal, without clusters or sheets of positive cells. The majority of the infiltrate is EBER-negative. Scattered EBV-positive B cells are a characteristic finding in angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; the absence of confluent EBER-positive large cells argues against a secondary EBV-positive large B-cell lymphoma in this field.

ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL shows sheets of EBER-positive large atypical B cells rather than sparse scattered positive cells.
In cHL the EBER signal localizes to large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+/CD15+, not predominantly small lymphocytes.
Acute EBV infection shows more numerous EBER-positive immunoblasts with preserved architecture and lacks an aberrant TFH T-cell population.

60974.recognize_zh: 單一顆拉長的漿細胞樣細胞，細胞質深藍色、邊緣略呈毛邊，細胞質與核上方隱約可見粉紫色細線狀條紋；影像放大倍率與解析度有限，題目所稱的類 Auer 棒狀包涵體只能部分辨識。
features: Single elongated cell with deep basophilic cytoplasm and slightly frayed margins
Eccentric oval nucleus with clumped chromatin, consistent with a plasma cell
Faint pink-purple linear/striated structures overlying the cytoplasm and nuclear region; not sharply resolved
Background red cells with occasional echinocyte (crenated cell) artifact
60974.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an isolated elongated plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with slightly frayed borders. Faint pink-purple linear striations are seen over the cytoplasm and nucleus, possibly representing azurophilic rod-like inclusions, although they are not sharply resolved at this magnification. Scattered red cells show crenation artifact. The image is compatible with a plasma cell containing Auer rod-like inclusions as described in the myeloma case, but the inclusions are only partially demonstrated.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: Auer rods reside in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO-positive, unlike these plasma cells with clumped chromatin.
Crystalline immunoglobulin accumulates in CD68/CD163-positive histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm, not in basophilic plasma cells.
Russell bodies are round eosinophilic globules rather than linear rod-shaped inclusions.
Lacks crystalline inclusions and is polytypic on light-chain studies.

60910.recognize_zh: CD61 免疫染色中骨小樑之間充滿強陽性的細胞，包括大小不一的巨核細胞與許多小型陽性細胞（megakaryoblasts），並呈流線狀排列於纖維化基質中，支持唐氏症相關骨髓性白血病的巨核芽細胞分化。
features: Strong cytoplasmic/membranous CD61 staining in numerous megakaryocytic cells between bony trabeculae
Positive cells range from large megakaryocytes to small mononuclear cells, indicating megakaryoblasts and micromegakaryocytes
Clustered and sheet-like distribution with streaming of positive cells, suggesting fibrotic stroma
Hematoxylin counterstain shows spindled negative stromal cells and bone trabeculae (blue-gray)
60910.describe_en: CD61 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights an extensive proliferation of megakaryocytic cells occupying the intertrabecular spaces. The positive cells range from small mononuclear forms consistent with megakaryoblasts and micromegakaryocytes to larger megakaryocytes, arranged in clusters and streaming sheets within a spindle-cell, fibrotic-appearing stroma. In the clinical context of Down syndrome with prior transient abnormal myelopoiesis, findings support myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome with megakaryoblastic differentiation.

ddx.vs: CD61 in MPN marks mainly large mature megakaryocytes, without the many small CD61-positive blasts seen here, and occurs in adults lacking GATA1 mutation.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Metastatic neuroblastoma or rhabdomyosarcoma cells are CD61 negative and express their own lineage markers (e.g. PHOX2B, myogenin).

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with other lineage differentiation and fibrosis
ddx.vs: Non-megakaryoblastic AML blasts are CD61 negative and instead express MPO, CD117 or monocytic markers.

60846.recognize_zh: 拼圖中多顆嗜中性白血球呈現巨大化、核分葉異常（假性 Pelger、環狀或斷裂核）、胞質毒性顆粒與空泡，並見吞噬體與一顆巨大母細胞樣細胞；搭配敗血症與 ECMO 病史，屬於反應性壓力性造血異常（stress dyspoiesis）。
features: Montage of peripheral blood myeloid cells with marked nuclear dysmorphism: bilobed pseudo-Pelger-like, ring/doughnut-like and fragmented nuclei, some with detached nuclear fragments
Enlarged neutrophils and precursors with coarse toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuolation (panel A)
Phagocytosed material and a large clear phagocytic vacuole displacing the nucleus
Hypogranular cells with bluish cytoplasm, Döhle-like areas and irregular cytoplasmic projections (panel B)
Occasional large cell with open, finely granular chromatin and broad basophilic cytoplasm with a bleb-like protrusion
60846.describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood leukocytes shows striking dysmorphic changes in the granulocytic lineage. Panel A highlights neutrophils with prominent toxic granulation, cytoplasmic vacuoles and phagocytosed debris, with irregular or bilobed nuclei. Panel B shows hypogranular granulocytes with pseudo-Pelger-Huët bilobation, ring-like and fragmented nuclei, detached nuclear fragments and basophilic cytoplasm, together with a large immature-appearing cell. In the setting of sepsis and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, these findings are consistent with marked reactive (stress) dyspoiesis; correlation with clinical course and resolution is required before considering a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: MDS dysplasia persists after recovery and is usually accompanied by cytopenias, clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities, and often blast increase, whereas stress dyspoiesis with toxic granulation and vacuolation resolves with the underlying sepsis.
Drug effect gives uniform bilobed hypogranular neutrophils without prominent toxic granulation, vacuolation or phagocytosis and reverses on drug withdrawal.
The inherited anomaly shows normogranular neutrophils with uniformly bilobed, coarsely clumped nuclei in an otherwise well patient, without toxic changes or bizarre fragmented nuclei.

60782.recognize_zh: 低倍下幾乎所有腫瘤細胞呈強而完整的 CD20 細胞膜染色（棕色環狀），片狀瀰漫排列、僅由細薄纖維血管間隔分開，表示這是 B 細胞來源的瀰漫性淋巴瘤；單憑 CD20 無法確定是母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of densely packed lymphoid cells separated by thin fibrovascular septa
Strong, crisp circumferential membranous CD20 staining in virtually all tumor cells
Cells appear medium-sized and uniform at this magnification
Stromal and endothelial cells within septa are CD20 negative
60782.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of medium-sized lymphoid cells separated by thin fibrovascular septa. Nearly all tumor cells show strong membranous CD20 positivity, while stromal elements are negative. This establishes B-cell lineage but is not specific for subtype. In combination with cyclin D1 nuclear positivity, blastoid cytology and a high Ki-67 index in the companion stains, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant.

ddx.vs: Also diffusely CD20 positive, but cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and are cyclin D1 negative (or only weakly positive in a subset) without CCND1 rearrangement.
Blasts are TdT and often CD34 positive with weak or absent CD20, and lack cyclin D1.
CD20-positive but CD10+/BCL6+, BCL2-negative and cyclin D1-negative with a starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement.
Blastoid cells would be CD20 negative and express myeloid markers such as MPO, CD33 or CD117.

60590.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見被纖維包圍、實心成片的腫瘤細胞巢；抹片中是成群、核圓、染色質呈椒鹽狀（salt-and-pepper）、細胞質淡而邊界不清的非造血細胞，易被誤認為漿細胞或淋巴瘤，細胞學免疫染色呈細胞質陽性（如 calcitonin/chromogranin），符合甲狀腺髓質癌骨髓轉移。
features: Biopsy: solid sheet/nest of monotonous tumor cells sharply demarcated by fibrous stroma, with adjacent fat
Aspirate: loose clusters of medium-sized non-hematopoietic cells with round to oval, often eccentric nuclei (plasmacytoid)
Finely granular 'salt-and-pepper' neuroendocrine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and pale, ill-defined cytoplasm
Cytologic immunostains (D, E): strong cytoplasmic positivity in tumor cell clusters, consistent with neuroendocrine/calcitonin markers (antibodies not labeled)
60590.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a large solid nest of monotonous tumor cells replacing the marrow, circumscribed by fibrous stroma. The aspirate smears show clusters of medium-sized cells with round, sometimes eccentric nuclei, finely stippled salt-and-pepper chromatin and pale ill-defined cytoplasm, which can mimic plasma cells. Immunocytochemistry on the smears shows strong cytoplasmic staining of the tumor cells; the specific antibodies are not labeled in the figure. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroendocrine carcinoma involving the bone marrow, in keeping with medullary thyroid carcinoma in the stated clinical context (confirmed with calcitonin, CEA and chromogranin).

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm and are CD138/light-chain positive, not calcitonin/chromogranin positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small cell lung carcinoma or other neuroendocrine tumor
ddx.vs: Small cell carcinoma shows nuclear molding and scant cytoplasm with TTF-1; calcitonin, CEA and elevated serum calcitonin favor medullary thyroid carcinoma.
These occur in children, form rosettes with scant cytoplasm and are PHOX2B or CD99/NKX2.2 positive rather than calcitonin positive.
Lymphoma cells are discohesive and CD45 positive, lacking the cohesive clusters and neuroendocrine chromatin.

60654.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片呈中等大小、核輪廓不規則且有切跡的單一型淋巴細胞瀰漫取代，周邊血可見核形不規則的非典型淋巴球，骨髓核染色 IHC 呈群聚陽性，綜合符合白血病化的被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）。
features: Spleen (A): diffuse sheets of monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular, notched to cleaved nuclei, dispersed chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm; no normal white/red pulp architecture visible
Peripheral blood (B): circulating atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, moderately condensed chromatin and scant-to-moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Bone marrow biopsy (C): hypercellular marrow with a diffuse-to-interstitial lymphoid infiltrate
Bone marrow IHC (D): nuclear-positive lymphoid cells forming an interstitial/nodular aggregate (nuclear pattern compatible with cyclin D1 or SOX11; antibody not labeled in image)
60654.describe_en: Sections of spleen show diffuse effacement by a monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular, notched nuclei, dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The peripheral blood smear contains atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear outlines and scant basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with an interstitial lymphoid infiltrate, and an immunostain with a nuclear pattern highlights an aggregate of the neoplastic cells (antibody not specified in the figure). Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with splenic, marrow and leukemic involvement, in keeping with the clinical history of spontaneous splenic rupture.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are round with block-like clumped chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD23+/CD200+ and cyclin D1/SOX11 negative, whereas these cells have irregular notched nuclei.
SMZL expands white pulp nodules with biphasic marginal-zone cells and villous lymphocytes in blood, and lacks nuclear cyclin D1 and t(11;14).
Prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and very high counts; a leukemic mantle cell lymphoma mimicking PLL is excluded by cyclin D1/SOX11 and t(11;14).
Circulating FL cells are small with deep narrow nuclear clefts ('buttock cells') and are CD10+/BCL6+ with t(14;18) rather than cyclin D1 positive.

captions: Spleen H&E: diffuse infiltrate of irregular, notched medium-sized lymphoid cells
Peripheral blood: circulating atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei
Bone marrow biopsy: hypercellular marrow with lymphoid infiltrate
Bone marrow IHC: nuclear-positive aggregate of lymphoma cells

60718.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中正常造血細胞之間混有一群大型上皮樣細胞，核大、染色質淡而帶明顯核仁、細胞質豐富（插圖），這些細胞的外觀與造血細胞不同；B 的免疫染色只標示散在的細胞，確切的非造血腫瘤類型無法僅從此圖判定。
features: Panel A: hypercellular marrow core adjacent to bone trabecula with a mixed population including scattered large atypical cells
Inset: large epithelioid cells with abundant pale-eosinophilic cytoplasm, large oval vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli, distinct from adjacent erythroid precursors with small dense nuclei
Atypical cells are dispersed among hematopoietic elements rather than forming an obvious cohesive nest at this magnification
Panel B: IHC (marker unlabeled) with brown cytoplasmic staining in scattered, partly elongated cells
Figure resolution and unlabeled stain limit specific classification
60718.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and contains, in addition to trilineage hematopoiesis, a population of large atypical epithelioid cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. An immunostain (marker not labeled in the figure) highlights scattered, partly elongated cells. The findings are suggestive of marrow infiltration by a non-hematopoietic malignancy; the specific tumor type cannot be established from this image alone and requires a full IHC panel (cytokeratin, S100/SOX10, melanocytic and lineage-specific markers) with clinical correlation.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma usually forms cohesive nests with desmoplasia and is cytokeratin positive.
Melanoma may show intranuclear pseudoinclusions and pigment and is S100/SOX10/HMB45 positive.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or histiocytic sarcoma
ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid mimics express CD45 with CD30/ALK or CD163/CD68 respectively, and lack epithelial/melanocytic markers.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and are CD61/CD42b positive, rather than vesicular round nuclei with prominent nucleoli.

60526.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中可見數顆芽細胞（blast），核染色質細緻；左上方一顆細胞一端拉出細長的細胞質尾巴（uropod），呈「手鏡狀」（hand mirror）外觀，其餘芽細胞圓形或核有凹陷，搭配 t(8;21) 臨床背景。
features: Several medium-to-large blasts with high-to-moderate N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin
One blast (upper left) with a tapered cytoplasmic tail (uropod), giving a hand-mirror configuration
Nuclei round to slightly indented, some with faint nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm; granules and Auer rods not resolvable at this magnification
Background red cells with central pallor and mild anisocytosis; no mature neutrophils in this field
60526.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several circulating blasts in a background of red cells with mild anisocytosis. The blasts are medium to large, with finely dispersed chromatin, slightly indented to round nuclei, and a thin rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. One blast displays a polar cytoplasmic projection (uropod), producing a hand-mirror appearance. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods cannot be confidently assessed at this magnification, and hand-mirror morphology itself is nonspecific for lineage. In the context of myeloid immunophenotype with aberrant CD19 and t(8;21)(q22;q22), findings are consistent with AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia with hand-mirror cells
ddx.vs: Hand-mirror cells occur in ALL as well, so lineage requires MPO/SBB cytochemistry and flow cytometry; Auer rods or salmon-colored granules favor AML with t(8;21).
APL cells are bilobed or heavily granular with multiple Auer rods (faggot cells) and PML::RARA, unlike these agranular-appearing blasts.
NPM1-mutated blasts show cup-shaped nuclear invaginations and CD34 negativity, while t(8;21) blasts are CD34+ often with CD19/PAX5 coexpression.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm without blast-type fine chromatin or nucleoli.

60462.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片低倍 CD20 染色，整個真皮並延伸至皮下脂肪呈大片強烈棕色陽性，只有表皮下一窄帶陰性，顯示瀰漫性 B 細胞浸潤由真皮一路侵犯到皮下組織。
features: Low-power skin biopsy with strong diffuse CD20 positivity throughout the dermis
Positive infiltrate extends into subcutaneous fat, surrounding adipocytes
Narrow uninvolved band beneath the negative epidermis
Negative collagen bundles and vessels interrupting the positive sheets in the superficial dermis
Denser staining in the deep dermis/subcutis
60462.describe_en: Low-power CD20 immunostain on a skin biopsy shows a diffuse, strongly positive B-cell infiltrate involving the entire dermis and extending into the subcutaneous fat, where it surrounds adipocytes. A narrow band of the papillary dermis and the epidermis are negative. The diffuse sheet-like growth favors a large B-cell lymphoma over a nodular low-grade process, although cytology must be confirmed on H&E. Findings are consistent with primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type, in conjunction with BCL2 and MUM1 positivity.

ddx.vs: PCFCL is often nodular to diffuse with CD21-positive meshworks, BCL2 negative/weak and MUM1 negative.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: PCMZL shows nodular B-cell aggregates with abundant T cells and plasma cells rather than confluent sheets.
Staging is needed because histology and CD20 staining cannot separate primary cutaneous from secondary involvement.

60270.recognize_zh: 幾乎整個視野的紅血球都呈兩端鈍圓、邊緣平行的橢圓形或長條形（遠超過25%），缺乏中央淡染區差異且大小相近，並伴隨少數破碎紅血球，符合遺傳性橢圓紅血球症（hereditary elliptocytosis）。
features: Majority of red cells (well over 25%) are elliptocytes: elongated oval to cigar-shaped cells with parallel sides and rounded ends
Elliptocytes are normochromic with little central pallor; size relatively uniform
Occasional fragmented and budding red cells
Segmented neutrophil with normal morphology (lower right) and adequate platelets
60270.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking predominance of elliptocytes, which account for the majority of red cells and appear as normochromic oval to elongated cigar-shaped cells with rounded ends. Occasional red cell fragments are noted, while teardrop cells and hypochromic pencil cells are not prominent. The single neutrophil and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis.

ddx.vs: Pencil cells are fewer, hypochromic and microcytic with marked anisocytosis, rather than a normochromic, uniform elliptocyte population exceeding 25%.
Elliptocytes accompany teardrop cells with a leukoerythroblastic picture (nucleated red cells, immature granulocytes).
Shows extreme microcytosis with bizarre fragments, microspherocytes and budding cells rather than predominantly intact elliptocytes.
Cells are broad stomatocytic ovalocytes with one or two transverse slits rather than slender elliptocytes.

60078.recognize_zh: 整個視野的有核細胞以前髓細胞、髓細胞、後髓細胞與帶狀嗜中性球為主，另見嗜伊紅球，而成熟中的母紅血球（多染性、正染性）幾乎沒有，只見少數小而深染的圓核細胞；這種顆粒球系明顯占優勢、紅血球系缺乏的骨髓符合 Diamond-Blackfan anemia。
features: Cellular aspirate with marked myeloid predominance
Granulocytic precursors at all stages: promyelocytes with azurophilic granules, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands
Occasional eosinophils with orange-red granules
Maturing erythroid precursors virtually absent; few small dark round nuclei (lymphocytes or rare late normoblasts)
No dysplasia or increase in blasts; red cells show brown staining artifact
60078.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a marked myeloid predominance. Granulocytic precursors show orderly maturation from promyelocytes through myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and bands, with occasional eosinophils, and there is no dysplasia or increase in blasts. Erythroid precursors are markedly decreased, with virtually no polychromatic or orthochromatic normoblasts identified; the few small dark round cells present likely represent lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with selective erythroid hypoplasia, supporting Diamond-Blackfan anemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic context.

ddx.vs: Similar erythroid hypoplasia, but affects older children with normal MCV, HbF, and erythrocyte ADA, and resolves within weeks.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19 pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Giant pronormoblasts with viral intranuclear inclusions are present and B19 PCR is positive.
Erythroid precursors remain present in normal proportions or are only relatively reduced, often with toxic granulation and left shift.
Shows granulocytic predominance with myelocyte and segmented neutrophil peaks, basophilia, and small hypolobated megakaryocytes with BCR::ABL1 fusion.

60014.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度極高、看不到脂肪，幾乎全被一致的不成熟細胞取代：細胞核卵圓至不規則、染色質淡而細緻、有小核仁，僅夾雜少量紅系前驅細胞與顆粒球，符合急性白血病的骨髓取代表現。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-total effacement and no visible fat
Sheets of immature mononuclear cells with oval to irregular or indented nuclei
Fine to vesicular chromatin with small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm
Scattered residual erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and occasional eosinophilic granulocytes
No megakaryocytes identified in this field; scattered small artifactual clear spaces
60014.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete replacement by sheets of immature mononuclear cells. The cells have oval to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed to vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Residual hematopoiesis is limited to scattered erythroid precursors and occasional granulocytes, and megakaryocytes are not apparent in this field. The morphology indicates marrow replacement by acute leukemia but cannot establish lineage; with flow cytometric B/myeloid mixed phenotype and t(9;22), the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia with BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: AML produces the same sheet-like marrow replacement, so lineage assignment depends on flow cytometry or IHC (MPO, CD19, PAX5, CD3) rather than H&E.
B-ALL can look identical on biopsy but is PAX5/TdT positive without an MPO-positive population.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase
ddx.vs: CML-BP often shows residual myeloid hyperplasia with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and fibrosis, and a prior chronic-phase history.
Lymphoma cells are usually larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, often in paratrabecular or nodular aggregates, and are CD20/PAX5 positive with TdT/CD34 negative.

29998.recognize_zh: 九格周邊血高倍圖：嗜酸性球（A–C，橘紅色顆粒）、嗜鹼性球（D–F，深紫粗顆粒遮蓋核）與嗜中性球（G–I）的核都分成過多葉（五葉以上），三系顆粒球同時過度分葉，配合服用 hydroxyurea 的病史即可聯想藥物引起的巨母細胞樣變化。
features: Panels A-C: eosinophils with four or more discrete nuclear lobes and abundant orange-red granules
Panels D-F: basophils with coarse purple-black granules partly obscuring multilobated, hypersegmented nuclei
Panels G-I: neutrophils with six or more nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments
Granulocytes are normal to slightly enlarged in size with preserved granulation
Background red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional macrocytes and oval forms
29998.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) composite shows nuclear hypersegmentation involving all three granulocytic lineages: eosinophils (A-C) with four or more lobes, basophils (D-F) with multilobated nuclei beneath coarse granules, and neutrophils (G-I) with six or more lobes. Cytoplasmic granulation is preserved without hypogranularity or pseudo-Pelger forms. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional macrocytes. In a patient with polycythemia vera receiving hydroxycarbamide, findings are consistent with drug-induced megaloblastoid change causing hypersegmentation of neutrophils, eosinophils and basophils.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so the drug history and normal B12/folate/methylmalonic acid levels are needed to attribute it to hydroxycarbamide.
The hereditary form is lifelong, affects only neutrophils without macrocytosis and is present in family members.
MDS characteristically shows hypolobated/hypogranular (pseudo-Pelger-Huet) neutrophils rather than uniform hypersegmentation with preserved granules.
These cause the same appearance and are separated only by clinical history and laboratory context.

29550.recognize_zh: 採血管內整管血液呈暗紅漆色、無清澈血漿層（A）；抹片中紅血球幾乎只剩淡色空殼（ghost cells），僅見少數白血球，其中嗜中性球含大空泡、可能為吞噬的紅血球殘骸（B、C），這種近乎完全的血管內溶血在敗血症（如產氣莢膜梭菌）應優先懷疑。
features: Panel A: blood collection tube with uniformly dark red, lacquered-appearing blood without a clear plasma layer
Panels B-C: near-complete loss of intact red cells, leaving only faint pale red cell ghosts
Neutrophil with multiple clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, possibly containing ingested red cell remnants
Scattered small dark basophilic clumps of platelets or possible bacterial aggregates in the background
Degenerating leukocyte with vacuolated cytoplasm in panel C
29550.describe_en: Composite figure. The blood tube (A) shows diffusely dark, lacquered blood consistent with massive hemolysis. The peripheral smear (B, C; Wright-Giemsa) is strikingly devoid of intact red cells, showing only faint red cell ghosts, with a few leukocytes including a neutrophil with prominent cytoplasmic vacuoles that may contain phagocytosed red cell remnants; definitive erythrophagocytosis is difficult to confirm at this magnification. Small dark basophilic clumps are present and could represent platelets or bacteria. Findings are consistent with fulminant intravascular hemolysis in severe sepsis, a pattern classically associated with Clostridium perfringens alpha-toxin, and warrant urgent blood cultures and Gram stain review.

ddx.vs: Artifactual hemolysis from traumatic draw or delayed processing does not remove nearly all red cells from the smear or cause neutrophil phagocytosis, and a repeat sample is normal.
It follows transfusion with a positive direct antiglobulin test, often with agglutination and spherocytes rather than ghosts with bacteria.
Plasmodium falciparum shows intraerythrocytic ring forms or gametocytes in residual red cells.

ddx.dx: Paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria or cold agglutinin disease
ddx.vs: These show red cell agglutination or erythrophagocytosis by neutrophils with a positive Donath-Landsteiner test or complement-positive DAT, without sepsis.

28526.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下見一團均一、核卵圓、染色質細緻、胞質淡的單核細胞結節，周邊血有核偏位的漿細胞樣細胞（箭頭）；免疫染色 CD123 強陽性、CD4 弱陽性，流式細胞儀 CD123 亮陽性、低 SSC 族群呈 CD4+ CD56− CD34−，代表 CMML 中成熟漿細胞樣樹突細胞（pDC）結節。
features: Low-power hypercellular marrow core with a dense nodular aggregate adjacent to trabecular bone (panel A)
High-power nodule of monotonous medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (panel B)
Peripheral blood cells with eccentric nuclei and pale blue cytoplasm resembling plasmacytoid cells (arrows, panel B inset)
Immunostains: nodule positive for CD45 and strongly for CD123, weak for CD4, and largely negative for CD68 (panel C)
Flow cytometry: CD123-bright, low side-scatter population (green) that is CD4-positive, CD56-negative and CD34/CD117-negative (panel D)
28526.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular and contains a discrete nodular aggregate adjacent to a trabecula composed of monotonous medium-sized cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm. The peripheral blood shows occasional plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and pale blue cytoplasm. By immunohistochemistry the nodule is CD45-positive and strongly CD123-positive with weak CD4 and minimal CD68 expression, and peripheral blood flow cytometry identifies a CD123-bright, CD4-positive, CD56-negative, CD34/CD117-negative population. In the setting of monocytosis and anemia, findings are consistent with clonal mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell nodules associated with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: BPDCN cells are immature blast-like cells that co-express CD56 with CD4/CD123/TCF4 and form diffuse infiltrates often with skin lesions, whereas these pDCs are CD56-negative mature nodules.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts are CD34 and/or CD117 positive or express monocytic markers with ≥20% blasts, while these cells are CD34/CD117-negative CD123-bright pDCs.
Lymphoid aggregates are composed of CD3+ or CD20+ lymphocytes and lack bright CD123 expression.
Mast cell aggregates are spindled, CD117/tryptase-positive and often CD25-positive rather than CD123-bright.

28526.stain: H&E, IHC: CD45, CD4, CD68, CD123; flow

28142.recognize_zh: 深色皮膚病人背部廣泛分布紫褐色斑疹，中央融合成片並伴有細碎鱗屑脫落，邊緣呈斑駁點狀；在深色皮膚上急性 GVHD 的紅斑常呈紫褐色或色素沉著，而非鮮紅色。
features: Widespread violaceous to dark brown macules and patches over the entire back and flanks
Central confluence with fine to plate-like scaling and superficial desquamation
Mottled, discrete macules at the periphery merging toward the center
Erythema appears violaceous/hyperpigmented on darkly pigmented skin
No bullae, sclerosis or deep ulceration visible
28142.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the back in a patient with darkly pigmented skin shows an extensive eruption of violaceous-brown macules and patches that coalesce centrally, with overlying fine scale and areas of superficial desquamation; the periphery shows discrete, mottled macules. No blisters, sclerotic plaques or ulcers are evident. In the post-transplant setting, this extensive desquamating eruption is consistent with cutaneous acute graft-versus-host disease, with hyperpigmentation reflecting skin of color or evolving post-inflammatory change; lichenoid chronic GVHD and drug eruption should be excluded clinically and histologically.

ddx.vs: Chronic lichenoid GVHD forms flat-topped violaceous papules and plaques with hyperkeratosis and later sclerosis rather than a diffuse desquamating macular eruption.

ddx.dx: Drug reaction (DRESS or exfoliative drug eruption)
ddx.vs: DRESS shows facial edema, eosinophilia and organ involvement after a latency of weeks following a culprit drug.
Requires a prior dermatologic history; histology shows psoriasiform or spongiotic change without basal apoptotic keratinocytes.

18350.recognize_zh: 拼圖中 26 顆嗜中性顆粒球的核各自彎折成 A 到 Z 字母形狀，多數為未分葉或帶狀核（band forms），含環狀核（O）；胞質淡粉帶細顆粒，反映感染時的左移（left shift）而非特定疾病。
features: Mature-sized granulocytes with abundant pale pink cytoplasm and fine neutrophilic granules
Nuclei mostly non-segmented or partially segmented, bent into letter-like band and U/S shapes
Occasional ring-shaped nucleus (O) and multilobed contorted forms (M, W, X)
Condensed chromatin consistent with mature band neutrophils rather than immature precursors
No obvious toxic vacuolation or Dohle bodies resolvable at this magnification
18350.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear cells are arranged as a composite of neutrophils whose nuclei assume shapes resembling each letter of the alphabet. The cells have abundant pale pink cytoplasm with fine granules and condensed chromatin, and most nuclei are unsegmented or incompletely segmented band forms, including a ring-shaped nucleus. These appearances reflect the normal plasticity of band neutrophil nuclei and, in a patient with fever and pneumonia, an increase in bands (left shift) consistent with a reactive neutrophilic response to infection.

ddx.vs: Pelger-Huet cells show bilobed spectacle-shaped or round nuclei with very coarse clumped chromatin and often hypogranular cytoplasm, rather than elongated band nuclei.

ddx.dx: Ring neutrophils in myelodysplasia or CML
ddx.vs: Occasional ring nuclei occur in reactive states, but numerous ring forms with dysgranulopoiesis or accompanying basophilia favor a myeloid neoplasm.
Monocytes have gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and lacy chromatin with folded rather than band-shaped nuclei.
Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus with indentation less than half the nuclear width, whereas bands have a uniformly thick curved nucleus.

18094.recognize_zh: 這是一張訊息傳導示意圖而非形態圖：圖A顯示未受抗原刺激時 TC21 經 Igα/Igβ 活化 PI3K（tonic BCR signaling），圖B顯示抗原結合後 LYN→SYK→BTK→PLCγ2 路徑，並標出 fostamatinib、GS-1101（idelalisib）、ibrutinib 的抑制位置。
features: Schematic diagram, not a morphologic image
Panel A: antigen-independent (tonic) BCR signaling via TC21 recruiting PI3K p85/p110delta and p110alpha
Panel B: antigen-bound BCR with Igalpha/Igbeta ITAM phosphorylation, LYN and SYK activation
Downstream PI3K (PIP2 to PIP3, AKT), BTK, PLCgamma2 leading to PKCbeta/IKK/NF-kB and Ca2+/NFAT
Drug targets marked: fostamatinib (SYK), GS-1101/idelalisib (PI3Kdelta), ibrutinib (BTK)
18094.describe_en: This is a schematic figure (Wiestner, Hematology 2012) illustrating upstream B-cell receptor (BCR) signaling relevant to CLL. Panel A depicts tonic, antigen-independent signaling in which TC21 associated with Igalpha/Igbeta activates PI3K isoforms. Panel B depicts antigen-induced signaling with LYN- and SYK-mediated ITAM phosphorylation, followed by PI3Kdelta/AKT and BTK/PLCgamma2 activation, leading to NF-kB and NFAT pathways. Inhibitor sites for fostamatinib (SYK), GS-1101 (idelalisib, PI3Kdelta) and ibrutinib (BTK) are indicated. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.

17390.recognize_zh: 兩顆成熟大小的中性球核分葉減少：右側為兩葉以細橋相連的眼鏡狀（pince-nez）核，左側為C形/環狀核，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質仍有細顆粒，符合假性 Pelger-Huët 異常（後天性分葉不良）。
features: Two neutrophils of normal size with mature, coarsely clumped chromatin
Right cell: bilobed nucleus with two round lobes joined by a thin strand (pince-nez/spectacle form)
Left cell: hyposegmented ring- or C-shaped nucleus without distinct lobes
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine specific granules; mild hypogranularity not clearly evident
Background RBCs normocytic with central pallor, some rouleaux-like overlap
17390.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature neutrophils with abnormal nuclear hyposegmentation. One has a bilobed nucleus with two rounded lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge in a pince-nez configuration, and the other has a non-segmented ring- or C-shaped nucleus; both show coarsely condensed mature chromatin and granulated cytoplasm. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet neutrophils, which in the acquired setting suggest myelodysplasia or drug effect and warrant review of the remaining leukocytes and clinical history.

ddx.vs: The congenital anomaly (LBR mutation) affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation in a healthy person, whereas pseudo-Pelger cells are a subset, often hypogranular, accompanied by other dysplasia or a causative drug.
Band forms have a curved nucleus of uniform width with less condensed chromatin, not the mature clumped chromatin of a hyposegmented neutrophil.
Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus with finer chromatin and a slightly larger cell size.
Morphology is identical to MDS-related change; separation relies on drug history and reversibility after withdrawal.

13038.recognize_zh: 左圖周邊血可見淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocytes）與橢圓形等異形紅血球，右圖骨小樑之間的骨髓被成巢、黏合的上皮細胞團與纖維性間質取代，符合乳癌轉移至骨髓造成的骨髓浸潤性（myelophthisic）改變。
features: PB: moderate poikilocytosis with teardrop cells (dacrocytes) and elliptocytes
PB: no nucleated red cells or immature granulocytes visible in this field
BM biopsy: intertrabecular space replaced by cohesive nests and cords of atypical epithelial cells
BM biopsy: tumor cells with hyperchromatic, crowded nuclei in a desmoplastic, fibrotic stroma
BM biopsy: normal hematopoietic elements essentially absent in the field; thickened bony trabeculae at edges
13038.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate poikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes; nucleated red cells and immature myeloid cells are not seen in this field. The bone marrow biopsy shows replacement of the intertrabecular marrow by cohesive nests of atypical epithelial cells with hyperchromatic, crowded nuclei embedded in a desmoplastic fibrous stroma, with no residual normal hematopoiesis in the field. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma to the bone marrow, in keeping with the known history of breast carcinoma; confirmation with cytokeratin, GATA3, and ER immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: PMF also causes teardrop cells and marrow fibrosis but shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and no cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor or melanoma
ddx.vs: These may form nests but are keratin-negative and express lineage markers such as synaptophysin, CD99, or SOX10/S100.
Hodgkin involvement shows scattered CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin cells in a mixed inflammatory fibrotic background rather than cohesive epithelial clusters.

ddx.dx: Clusters of normal megakaryocytes or osteoblasts
ddx.vs: Osteoblasts line trabeculae in single rows with eccentric nuclei and megakaryocytes are single, lobulated cells, not cohesive glandular nests.

3694.recognize_zh: 中倍下一個反應性濾泡，有淡染生發中心與完整深染外套層，濾泡周圍與外套層邊緣散布淡嗜伊紅的小群類上皮組織球，並向濾泡侵入，這種排列是弓漿蟲淋巴結炎的特徵。
features: Reactive follicle with a pale germinal center and a well-preserved dark mantle zone of small lymphocytes
Germinal center contains mixed centroblasts, centrocytes and histiocytes
Small loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with pale pink cytoplasm scattered in the perifollicular tissue and encroaching on the mantle and germinal center
Interfollicular zone with small lymphocytes, paler cells and small vessels
No necrosis, well-formed granulomas or giant cells
3694.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node shows a reactive follicle with a polarized germinal center and an intact mantle zone. Small, poorly formed clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are scattered around the follicle and encroach on the mantle and germinal center. There is no necrosis and no well-formed granulomas or giant cells. Findings are consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis; serologic confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Ordinary follicular hyperplasia lacks the small epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on germinal centers.
Infectious granulomas are larger and well circumscribed with giant cells and often necrosis, and organisms can be shown with AFB or GMS stains.
NLPHL shows large expansile nodules with CD20-positive LP (popcorn) cells and may have epithelioid histiocytes at the nodule periphery, rather than small reactive follicles.

3502.recognize_zh: 兩顆組織球有大量淡灰藍色、邊界不清的細胞質，下方那顆細胞質內含兩顆深染圓形核（被吞噬的有核紅血球或淋巴球）與數個血小板大小的顆粒，屬噬血現象，配合臨床可提示家族性 HLH。
features: Two histiocytes with abundant, pale gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and ill-defined borders
Oval nuclei with fine reticular chromatin
Lower histiocyte contains two dense round engulfed nuclei and small platelet-sized particles
Scattered small dark nucleated red cells and lymphocytes in the background
Red cells show refractile drying artifact
3502.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and oval nuclei with fine chromatin. One histiocyte contains two phagocytosed dense round nuclei, likely nucleated red cells or lymphocytes, along with small platelet-sized fragments. Background red cells show refractile drying artifact. Findings represent hemophagocytosis; in an infant or child with fever, cytopenias and splenomegaly, together with genetic testing (PRF1, UNC13D, STX11, STXBP2) and impaired NK/cytotoxic function, this supports familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; familial HLH is defined by biallelic mutations or defective degranulation/perforin expression.
Langerhans cells have grooved, reniform nuclei and are CD1a/langerin positive, and are not typically phagocytic of intact cells.

ddx.dx: Macrophages with transfused red cells or debris
ddx.vs: Occasional phagocytosis after transfusion is common and nonspecific; HLH requires diagnostic clinical and laboratory criteria.
Tingible body macrophages contain irregular apoptotic nuclear fragments rather than intact round nuclei of hematopoietic cells.

1198.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀雙參數點圖：Y 軸 CD3 (ECD)、X 軸 MPO (FITC)，77.6% 的細胞落在右上象限（E2），代表同一群原始細胞同時表現 CD3 與 MPO，這是 T/骨髓混合表型急性白血病的關鍵證據。
features: Two-parameter flow cytometry dot plot: CD3-ECD (y-axis) versus MPO-FITC (x-axis), log scales
Quadrant E2 (CD3+ MPO+) contains 77.6% of gated events as a single cohesive population
E1 (CD3+ MPO-) 8.7%, E3 (double negative) 3.4%, E4 (CD3- MPO+) 10.3%
Dual-positive population shows continuous MPO expression spanning about two logs
CD3 intensity is dim-to-moderate, typical of cytoplasmic staining in blasts
1198.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of gated events displays CD3 (ECD) against myeloperoxidase (FITC). A single dominant population (77.6%, quadrant E2) co-expresses CD3 and MPO, with small CD3-only (8.7%), MPO-only (10.3%) and double-negative (3.4%) fractions. Co-expression of cytoplasmic CD3 and MPO on the same blast population fulfills the lineage-assignment criteria for both T and myeloid lineages. Findings are consistent with mixed-phenotype acute leukemia, T/myeloid, provided the gate is on blasts, CD3 staining is cytoplasmic, and BCR::ABL1 and KMT2A rearrangements are excluded.

ddx.dx: T-lymphoblastic leukemia with nonspecific MPO staining
ddx.vs: Low-level MPO by flow alone can be nonspecific; true myeloid lineage should be supported by bright MPO or confirmation by cytochemistry.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant CD7 or dim CD3
ddx.vs: AML may aberrantly express CD7, but cytoplasmic CD3 at T-lineage-defining intensity as here argues for T/myeloid MPAL.

ddx.dx: Bilineal acute leukemia (two separate blast populations)
ddx.vs: Bilineal leukemia shows distinct CD3+ MPO- and CD3- MPO+ populations, whereas here most events co-express both markers.

1966.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片箭頭處為圓核細胞，胞質充滿粗大、橘紅與暗紫混合的顆粒，屬早期嗜伊紅前驅細胞（eosinophilic promyelocyte/myelocyte）；同視野右側另有胞質顆粒為藍黑色、覆蓋核的嗜鹼性細胞，左下有分裂期細胞，可對照比較。
features: Arrowed round cell with a round nucleus and cytoplasm filled with coarse granules of mixed orange-pink and dark purple tones
Granules are larger and more uniform than neutrophilic azurophilic granules
Nearby basophilic cell (right mid-field) with blue-black granules overlying a lobulated nucleus for comparison
Mitotic figure in a granulocytic precursor (lower left)
Background of neutrophilic myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils, erythroid precursors and fat spaces
1966.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows active granulopoiesis with neutrophilic precursors at various stages, erythroid precursors and a mitotic figure. The arrowed cell has a round nucleus and cytoplasm packed with coarse granules of mixed orange-pink and dark purple coloration, consistent with an early eosinophilic precursor in which some granules retain basophilic staining. For contrast, a basophil-lineage cell with blue-black granules overlying the nucleus is present to the right. This image illustrates normal eosinophil precursor morphology and its distinction from basophils.

ddx.vs: Granules are blue-black, fewer, variable in size and overlie the nucleus without orange-pink granules.
Contains fine azurophilic granules with a perinuclear Golgi zone and visible nucleoli, not coarse eosinophilic granules.
Dark granules are fine and dispersed in neutrophil-lineage cells without refractile orange granules.

1326.recognize_zh: 這是一張皮膚臨床照片，有毛髮的皮膚上可見多處不規則、線狀到斑片狀的紫斑與點狀出血（purpura/ecchymoses），沒有隆起；在類澱粉沉積症（amyloidosis）合併後天性第十因子缺乏時，皮膚出血是線索之一，但照片本身不具特異性。
features: Clinical photograph of hair-bearing skin
Multiple irregular, flat, red-purple purpuric macules with linear and streaky configuration
Scattered pinpoint petechiae at the periphery
No palpable/elevated lesions, ulceration or necrosis evident
Surrounding skin otherwise unremarkable
1326.describe_en: Clinical photograph of hair-bearing skin shows multiple flat, irregular red-purple purpuric macules and ecchymoses with a streaky, linear arrangement and scattered petechiae. The lesions do not appear raised or necrotic. In systemic AL amyloidosis, cutaneous bleeding results from vascular fragility due to amyloid infiltration of vessel walls and can be aggravated by acquired factor X deficiency from adsorption of factor X onto amyloid fibrils. The photograph is not diagnostic by itself; confirmation requires tissue Congo red staining, a prolonged PT and aPTT with low factor X activity, and a monoclonal protein work-up.

ddx.vs: Senile purpura occurs on sun-damaged forearms of elderly patients with normal coagulation studies, whereas amyloid-associated bleeding may show prolonged PT/aPTT from low factor X and periorbital 'pinch' purpura.
ITP purpura is accompanied by a markedly low platelet count with normal PT/aPTT.
Vasculitic lesions are typically palpable purpura on dependent areas, with neutrophilic small-vessel vasculitis on biopsy rather than Congo red-positive vessel walls.

2926.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見多顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富、淡嗜雙色性（amphophilic），圓形偏心核帶明顯單一大核仁，散在淡粉紅纖維狀基質中，符合神經母細胞瘤化療後的節細胞分化（ganglion cell differentiation）。
features: Large cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Round, often eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin and a single prominent nucleolus (ganglion-like cells)
Occasional binucleated ganglion-like cells
Pale pink fibrillary (neuropil/Schwannian) stroma surrounding the cells
Scattered brown hemosiderin pigment and adjacent residual hematopoietic cells
2926.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a focus of large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, round eccentric vesicular nuclei, and single prominent nucleoli, consistent with maturing and mature ganglion cells, occasionally binucleated. These cells lie within pale eosinophilic fibrillary stroma with scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages. Residual hematopoietic cells are present at the periphery. Primitive small round blue cells are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma showing ganglion cell differentiation following chemotherapy.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have multilobated nuclei without a single prominent nucleolus, and are CD61/CD42b positive rather than synaptophysin/PHOX2B positive.
Osteoblasts line trabecular surfaces with an eccentric nucleus and a perinuclear hof, and lack neuropil-like stroma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or rhabdomyosarcoma with large cells
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive glands or nests (keratin positive) and rhabdomyoblasts show cross-striations/desmin, unlike ganglion cells in fibrillary stroma.

1262.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆嗜中性球核分葉不足：右下那顆呈花生／啞鈴狀的雙葉核（pince-nez），左上那顆為未分葉的腎形核，但兩者染色質都已粗塊濃縮、細胞質顆粒成熟，符合 Pelger-Huët 變異。
features: Two neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei
Lower right cell: bilobed peanut/dumbbell-shaped nucleus (pince-nez form)
Upper left cell: non-segmented, kidney-shaped nucleus
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin in both cells
Pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; small vacuoles in the lower right cell
Scattered platelets in the background
1262.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei. The cell at lower right has a bilobed, peanut-shaped (pince-nez) nucleus, and the cell at upper left has a non-segmented kidney-shaped nucleus. Both show coarsely clumped mature chromatin and pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules, and the lower right cell contains a few small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Findings are consistent with Pelger-Huët-type hyposegmented neutrophils; distinguishing the inherited anomaly from acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët change requires assessing the proportion of affected cells, granulation and clinical history.

ddx.vs: Band neutrophils have a curved sausage-shaped nucleus with less condensed chromatin, whereas these cells show coarse mature chromatin with dumbbell or non-lobed forms.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly (MDS, drugs such as mycophenolate)
ddx.vs: Acquired forms frequently accompany hypogranularity and other dysplasia and affect a variable subset of neutrophils, whereas the inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils.
Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus with less condensed chromatin and occur in marrow or left-shifted blood, not with fully mature clumped chromatin.

1070.recognize_zh: 中央分節中性球細胞質有粗的紫紅色毒性顆粒，靠近細胞核上方可見一個小的淡藍色斑塊（Döhle 小體）；左上方另有一個偏藍紫色的大型多染性紅血球。
features: Segmented neutrophil with coarse, dark purple toxic granulation throughout the cytoplasm
Small pale blue cytoplasmic inclusion near the upper nuclear lobe (Döhle body)
Two to three nuclear lobes with condensed chromatin
Large polychromatophilic red cell in the background
Occasional fragmented/irregular red cell; platelet present
1070.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil with coarse, dark cytoplasmic granulation and a small pale blue cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a Döhle body. A large polychromatophilic red cell and occasional irregular red cells are present in the background. Findings are consistent with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, reflecting a reactive neutrophil response to infection or inflammation.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger and more discrete, seen in most granulocytes with giant platelets and no toxic granulation.
Alder-Reilly granules are uniformly large and dark in granulocytes, monocytes and lymphocytes and do not reflect acute infection.
Normal neutrophils have fine lilac granules and lack pale blue peripheral inclusions.

1134.recognize_zh: 與上一張同一視野，箭頭指向左上方含四個圓形核的巨大漿細胞，細胞質深藍、有核周淡染區，周圍多顆核偏位漿細胞，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Arrow indicates a large tetranucleate plasma cell with abundant deep blue cytoplasm
Four separate round nuclei with coarse chromatin and faint nucleoli
Numerous surrounding plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof
Occasional plasma cells with more open chromatin
Background granulocytes including eosinophilic forms and red cells
1134.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells, and an arrow highlights a large plasma cell containing four discrete round nuclei within abundant deep blue cytoplasm. Surrounding plasma cells have eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs, with some showing less mature chromatin. Granulocytes and red cells are present in the background. Multinucleated atypical plasma cells support plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have many more uniform nuclei and granular cytoplasm without a hof.
Megakaryocytes show a single lobulated connected nucleus and granular pinkish cytoplasm rather than separate round nuclei.
Plasmablastic lymphoma consists of sheets of large immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli, usually EBV positive, rather than mature-appearing plasma cells.

4142.recognize_zh: 周邊血液低倍下可見多顆中型、核質比高、核圓且細胞質稀少的單核細胞，數量明顯多於旁邊唯一的嗜中性球，提示循環母細胞；此倍率無法看清染色質與核仁，T 淋巴母細胞需流式確認。
features: Increased circulating medium-sized mononuclear cells with very high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with scant cytoplasm; chromatin and nucleoli not resolvable at low power
Only a single mature neutrophil in the field, suggesting relative neutropenia
Red cells show rouleaux-like stacking and scattered target-like forms, likely thick-area artifact
Platelets appear decreased in this field
4142.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized mononuclear cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and round nuclei, while mature neutrophils are sparse and platelets appear reduced. Red cells show stacking and target-like forms in a thicker area of the smear. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of circulating blasts and, in context, consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, TdT, CD7) is required.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and require flow cytometry showing CD19/CD79a rather than cytoplasmic CD3.
AML blasts may have granules or Auer rods and express MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117.
CLL cells have clumped mature chromatin, smudge cells and a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.

4014.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中兩顆大型細胞緊貼在一起，核質比極高、染色質細緻、細胞質極少，交界處呈核互相擠壓變形（nuclear molding）；形似母細胞或淋巴瘤細胞，但成對擠壓的外觀應想到小細胞神經內分泌癌。
features: Two adjacent large cells with very high N:C ratio and scant rim of cytoplasm
Finely granular, evenly dispersed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Nuclear molding where the two cells abut
Red cells poorly spread with artifact (thick or air-drying area of the smear)
No cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles in the atypical cells
4014.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a pair of large atypical cells with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely granular chromatin and scant cytoplasm, with nuclear molding at their interface. Red cell morphology in the field is distorted by smear artifact. Cytologically the cells could be mistaken for blasts or leukemic lymphoma cells, but the cohesive molding is a clue to a non-hematopoietic small round cell tumor. Findings are suggestive of circulating carcinoma cells, compatible with small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma; immunophenotyping (CD45 negative, keratin, synaptophysin, INSM1) is required.

ddx.vs: Blasts are discohesive single cells without nuclear molding and express CD45 with lineage markers on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of lymphoma (e.g., Burkitt or mantle cell blastoid)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are discohesive, may show vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, and are CD45 and B- or T-cell marker positive, unlike keratin-positive carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic neuroblastoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma forms rosettes with fibrillary neuropil in children; separation requires immunostains and clinical age.

3822.recognize_zh: 中倍脾臟切片中紅髓內散布大量成群的淡染、透亮泡沫狀組織球，夾在充血的紅髓與小血管之間，是 Niemann-Pick 病脾臟泡沫細胞浸潤的表現。
features: Numerous clusters of large pale histiocytes with clear, foamy cytoplasm throughout the red pulp
Storage cells with small round nuclei, arranged in cords and nests
Intervening congested red pulp with red cells and scattered lymphocytes
Small arterioles/vessels with preserved walls
No white pulp in this field; no atypical infiltrate
3822.describe_en: Section of spleen at intermediate power shows numerous clusters and cords of large histiocytes with pale, clear, foamy cytoplasm and small bland nuclei distributed throughout congested red pulp. Scattered small lymphocytes and small vessels are present, and no atypical lymphoid infiltrate is identified. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by lipid-laden foam cells, compatible with Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have eosinophilic, fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than clear vacuolated cytoplasm.
HCL red pulp infiltrates consist of monotonous small B cells with blood lakes rather than large foamy histiocytes.
Infectious foamy histiocytes contain organisms demonstrable by AFB or PAS stains and often accompany granulomas.

3758.recognize_zh: 低倍血液抹片中嗜中性球明顯增多、多為帶狀或分葉少的核，另散布幾個形狀不規則、星芒狀的紫色大團塊（疑為大型血小板或血小板聚集），符合 G-CSF 刺激後的周邊血液變化。
features: Neutrophilic leukocytosis with many band and hyposegmented neutrophils
Several irregular, stellate, purple granular bodies about neutrophil size, favored to be giant platelets or small platelet clumps
Occasional larger mononuclear cells
No obvious circulating blasts at this magnification
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis; cytoplasmic granule detail not resolvable
3758.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows neutrophilic leukocytosis with a left shift toward band forms. Scattered irregular stellate purple granular bodies of approximately neutrophil size are present and are favored to represent giant platelets or small platelet aggregates. Red cells are normocytic without notable poikilocytosis, and blasts are not evident at this magnification. In the setting of growth factor therapy, findings are consistent with a G-CSF–related neutrophilic response; granulation and Döhle bodies require high-power review.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, so history of G-CSF use versus infection is required to separate them.
CML shows myelocyte-predominant left shift with basophilia and eosinophilia and BCR::ABL1 rearrangement.
Micromegakaryocytes have a distinct nucleus with scant granular cytoplasm, whereas platelet clumps lack a nucleus.

3630.recognize_zh: 標題寫的是細胞散佈圖（cytogram），但這張是周邊血抹片：有兩顆被紅血球擠壓成方角形的小淋巴球、一顆正常分葉中性球，紅血球有不少乾燥造成的折光性假影；看不到腫瘤性細胞，屬正常血球形態。
features: Two small lymphocytes with round nuclei and scant pale-blue cytoplasm, deformed into angular shapes by adjacent RBCs
One mature segmented neutrophil with normal lobation and granulation
RBCs with refractile, crisp-edged central inclusions consistent with drying/water artifact
Occasional small dark precipitate particles and scattered normal platelets
No blasts, dysplasia, or inclusions in leukocytes
3630.describe_en: Although the title refers to a cytogram, the image is a peripheral blood smear rather than an analyzer scatter plot. It shows two small mature lymphocytes, compressed into angular shapes by surrounding red cells, and a normal segmented neutrophil. Many red cells contain refractile, sharply outlined clear areas typical of drying (water) artifact, and a few stain precipitate particles are present; these should not be mistaken for inclusions or parasites. No blasts or dysplastic features are seen, and the findings represent normal leukocyte morphology.

ddx.vs: Drying artifact is refractile and colorless with sharp edges, whereas parasites have blue cytoplasm and red-purple chromatin dots.
True inclusions are basophilic and stay in focus with the cell, unlike the refractile clear artifacts here.
The cytoplasmic angularity here is compression artifact from neighboring RBCs rather than circumferential hair-like projections with abundant cytoplasm.

3566.recognize_zh: 左邊中性球細胞質邊緣有淡藍色、形狀清楚的包涵體，貼著它還有一顆大小接近小淋巴球的巨大血小板（giant platelet）；中性球包涵體加上巨大血小板符合 May-Hegglin 異常。
features: Segmented neutrophils with pale-blue, well-defined cytoplasmic inclusions at the cell periphery (Döhle-like bodies)
Giant platelet with central granulomere adjacent to the left neutrophil, approaching RBC size
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal; no vacuoles or toxic granulation
Paucity of normal-sized platelets in the field
Normochromic, normocytic RBCs
3566.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two segmented neutrophils, with the left cell containing well-defined pale-blue cytoplasmic inclusions near the membrane. A giant platelet nearly the size of a red cell lies adjacent to it, and normal-sized platelets are sparse. Neutrophil granulation is otherwise normal without toxic change. Findings are consistent with May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder).

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies are fainter and less discrete, occur with toxic granulation, and are not associated with giant platelets.
Giant platelets are present but neutrophils lack inclusions, and GPIb-IX-V deficiency is shown by absent ristocetin agglutination.
Large platelets appear pale grey and agranular, and neutrophils have no cytoplasmic inclusions.

3310.recognize_zh: 抹片中一群小到中型的原始淋巴細胞，核質比極高、細胞質僅剩一圈嗜鹼性邊緣，染色質細緻到略濃縮、核仁不明顯，大小略有差異且無顆粒；與成熟淋巴球相比染色質較均勻細緻，符合前驅 B 細胞急性淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Cluster of small to intermediate blasts, about 1-1.5 times red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with fine to slightly condensed homogeneous chromatin
Inconspicuous nucleoli; no cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Mild size heterogeneity among blasts
One disrupted granular pink cell and normochromic red cells in the background
3310.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of small to intermediate-sized blasts in a background of normochromic red cells. The blasts have very high N:C ratios with a scant rim of basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei with fine to slightly condensed homogeneous chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli, with mild variation in size. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are absent, and a single disrupted granular cell is present nearby. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry is required to confirm precursor B-cell lineage (CD19, CD10, CD79a, TdT, CD34).

ddx.vs: Hematogones are similar cytologically but show a normal, continuous maturation pattern of CD10, CD20 and CD34 on flow cytometry without aberrant antigens.
T-ALL is morphologically indistinguishable and requires cytoplasmic CD3 positivity without B-lineage markers.
