ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are larger with more cytoplasm and express CD13/CD33/CD117 rather than B-cell markers.
CLL cells have coarse, clumped soccer-ball chromatin and are mature CD5+/CD23+ B cells without TdT.

3374.recognize_zh: 三色染色（trichrome）下，骨髓腔內有大量藍染膠原纖維呈束狀、漩渦狀穿插在造血細胞之間，右上可見紅染骨小樑，代表膠原性纖維化（collagen fibrosis）。
features: Blue-staining collagen bands streaming and swirling through the marrow space on trichrome
Collagen fibers intersect around and separate residual hematopoietic cells
Cellular intertrabecular space with spindled stromal cells
Scattered gray-brown pigmented cells, likely hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Adjacent bony trabecula (red) at upper right; small vessel at lower center
3374.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy, Masson trichrome stain, shows an intertrabecular space extensively replaced by blue-staining collagen bundles arranged in streaming and whorled fascicles. Residual hematopoietic cells and spindled stromal cells are entrapped between the collagen bands, and scattered pigmented macrophages are present. Adjacent trabecular bone is seen at the upper right. Findings are consistent with collagen fibrosis of the marrow (trichrome-positive, corresponding to grade MF-3); correlation with reticulin grading, clinical history and molecular studies is needed to separate reactive from neoplastic causes.

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered, atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis with driver mutations (JAK2/CALR/MPL), whereas reactive fibrosis lacks megakaryocytic atypia.
Metastatic tumor shows cohesive epithelial clusters within the fibrosis that are keratin-positive, not seen here.
Marrow Hodgkin lymphoma shows fibrosis with a mixed inflammatory background containing CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells.
HCL shows a diffuse reticulin (not collagen) increase with fried-egg lymphoid cells that are CD20+/annexin A1+/BRAF V600E+.

3246.recognize_zh: 中央巨噬細胞細胞質裡有十多個大小一致的小橢圓形酵母菌，周圍有透亮暈圈、內含偏心新月形染色質；右側還有兩顆游離在外的菌體，典型 Histoplasma capsulatum。
features: Macrophage with central round nucleus and foamy cytoplasm containing numerous small intracellular yeasts
Yeasts uniform, oval, about 2-4 um, each with a clear halo and eccentric crescentic chromatin
Pair of extracellular yeasts at right of the macrophage
Additional vacuolated macrophages and a mitotic figure/degenerating cell at bottom
No hyphae or pseudohyphae
3246.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows several vacuolated macrophages; the central macrophage contains numerous uniform, small oval yeast forms with clear halos and eccentric crescent-shaped chromatin. Two similar organisms are present extracellularly to the right. No hyphae are seen. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); correlation with GMS stain, antigen testing and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a nucleus plus a bar-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated, sausage-shaped forms dividing by a central septum (fission) rather than budding.
Cryptococcus is larger (4-10 um), variably sized, with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.
Overlying platelets are irregular granular fragments without a refractile wall, halo or crescentic nucleus.

3182.recognize_zh: 同一視野兩顆異常淋巴細胞：左側核呈多個瘤狀突起分葉，右側核有卷曲折疊的腦迴狀溝紋，兩者染色質都濃縮、細胞質淡藍中量，呈現 ATLL 核形不規則的多樣性。
features: Two medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells
Left cell: nucleus with multiple knob-like lobes and protrusions
Right cell: convoluted, folded nucleus with cerebriform grooves and incipient lobation
Condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale-blue cytoplasm; background normocytic red cells
3182.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two atypical lymphoid cells with markedly irregular nuclei: one has multiple knob-like lobes, and the other shows a convoluted, folded nucleus with cerebriform grooves. Both cells have condensed chromatin and moderate pale-blue cytoplasm. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, which characteristically shows a spectrum from convoluted to polylobated flower-like nuclei; HTLV-1 serology and T-cell immunophenotyping are recommended.

ddx.vs: Sezary syndrome shows predominantly cerebriform nuclei without true flower-like lobation and is HTLV-1 negative with CD26 and CD7 loss but typically CD25 dim.
T-PLL cells usually have a single visible nucleolus, cytoplasmic blebs and TCL1A overexpression rather than polylobated nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytes have round or oval nuclei with abundant cytoplasm indented by adjacent red cells and lack multilobation.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules.

2990.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中許多中大型細胞的細胞質布滿空泡，另有前驅細胞含粗大紅色巨大顆粒（中上方）；空泡化的組織球樣細胞增多，提示 Chediak-Higashi 症候群合併加速期（HLH 樣）變化。
features: Numerous medium to large cells with prominently vacuolated cytoplasm (histiocytes/monocytoid cells)
Occasional precursors with coarse red-orange giant granules
Admixed granulocytic precursors with coarse granules and small dark erythroid precursors
Scattered lymphocytes
Hemodilute background with abundant red cells
2990.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with numerous medium to large cells containing abundant vacuolated cytoplasm, consistent with activated histiocytes/monocytoid cells. Occasional granulocytic precursors contain coarse, abnormally large red-orange granules, and erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are admixed. Definite engulfment of intact hematopoietic cells is not clearly demonstrated in this field. Findings are consistent with Chediak-Higashi syndrome and suggest an accelerated (HLH-like) phase with histiocytic activation.

ddx.vs: Familial HLH lacks giant granules in granulocytes; genetic testing for PRF1/UNC13D/STX11 versus LYST confirms.
Monoblasts/promonocytes are immature with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are clonal by flow, unlike mature vacuolated histiocytes.
Griscelli causes albinism with HLH but lacks giant cytoplasmic granules; hair shaft shows large uneven pigment clumps.

2862.recognize_zh: 高倍切片中一片形態一致的中型母細胞，核圓形至卵圓、部分有核摺痕，染色質細緻呈粉塵狀，核仁小而不明顯，細胞質稀少淡染，符合淋巴母細胞。
features: Monotonous sheet of intermediate-sized blasts
Round to oval nuclei, some with indentations or convolutions
Finely dispersed (dusty) chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant, pale, ill-defined cytoplasm
Occasional apoptotic/hyperchromatic cells; no cohesive or glandular pattern
2862.describe_en: High-power section shows a diffuse, monotonous population of intermediate-sized blasts with round to oval nuclei, occasional nuclear convolutions, finely dispersed chromatin, small inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm. Scattered apoptotic cells are present. There is no cohesive or glandular growth. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic lymphoma; confirmation with TdT and lineage markers is required.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells show multiple nucleoli, squared-off borders, amphophilic cytoplasm and a prominent starry-sky pattern, and are TdT negative.
Myeloid sarcoma may show eosinophilic myelocytes and is MPO/lysozyme positive.
Thymoma contains cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells among immature T cells, which are not seen here.

2734.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片以顆粒球系增生為主，可見前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞到桿狀與分葉核球；部分細胞偏大、核呈異常 C 形或環狀的巨大桿狀核，細胞質顆粒不均，另有核過度分葉，屬於骨髓造血異常（dysmyelopoiesis）的形態線索。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation
Promyelocytes/myelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules alongside cells with reduced, uneven granulation
Enlarged metamyelocytes and bands with abnormal C-shaped or ring-like nuclei (giant band forms)
Mature neutrophils with irregular or excessive nuclear lobation
Scattered erythroid precursors; no obvious increase in blasts in this field
2734.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field dominated by granulocytic precursors with full maturation from promyelocytes to segmented neutrophils. Several granulocytes show dysplastic-appearing features, including enlarged metamyelocytes and bands with abnormal C-shaped to ring-like nuclei, uneven or reduced cytoplasmic granulation, and irregular nuclear lobation in mature neutrophils. Erythroid precursors are scattered, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are suggestive of dysmyelopoiesis; because similar changes occur with megaloblastic anemia, drugs, growth factors and infection, quantification (at least 10% of granulocytes) and clinical correlation are required before attributing them to a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Giant metamyelocytes and bands with hypersegmented neutrophils occur in B12/folate deficiency together with megaloblastic erythroid precursors and resolve with replacement.
MDS is supported by dysplasia in at least 10% of cells of a lineage, hypogranular pseudo-Pelger forms, cytopenias and clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.

ddx.dx: G-CSF effect or infection-related left shift
ddx.vs: Growth factor or infection shows left-shifted granulopoiesis with toxic granulation and Dohle bodies rather than hypogranulation and nuclear dysplasia.

2670.recognize_zh: 中央細胞邊緣不規則，細胞質與核上覆蓋大量大小不一、深紫黑色的粗顆粒，把淡紫色分葉核遮得模糊不清；這種顆粒蓋住核的外觀就是嗜鹼性球。
features: Granulocyte about the size of a neutrophil with irregular outline
Numerous coarse, variably sized dark purple-black granules
Granules overlie and obscure a pale, lobulated nucleus
Scant visible cytoplasm between granules
Nearby platelets and clumped platelet fragments; normochromic red cells
2670.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte packed with coarse, irregularly sized, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure a pale lobulated nucleus. The cell outline is slightly irregular. Scattered platelets and small platelet clumps are present among normochromic red cells. Findings are consistent with a basophil; persistent absolute basophilia should prompt evaluation for a myeloproliferative neoplasm, particularly CML.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger tissue cells with a round, central non-lobulated nucleus and densely packed uniform granules, and are rarely seen in blood.
Eosinophils have uniform round orange-red granules that do not obscure the clearly bilobed nucleus.
Toxic neutrophils have finer dark granules in pink cytoplasm with a clearly visible multilobed nucleus.

2606.recognize_zh: 這是G顯帶部分核型圖（非形態學影像），並排呈現正常15、der(15)、正常17與der(17)，箭頭標示斷點：der(15)變長而der(17)變短，代表15與17號染色體長臂互相易位，即APL的t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2)。
features: Partial G-banded karyotype displayed as inverted (light-on-dark) image
Normal chromosome 15 paired with a der(15) that is longer, with an arrow at the 15q breakpoint
Normal chromosome 17 paired with a markedly shortened der(17), with an arrow at the 17q breakpoint
Pattern indicates reciprocal exchange of distal 15q and 17q material, t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2)
Resolution does not permit precise band-level assignment
2606.describe_en: This is a partial G-banded karyotype, not a morphologic image, showing a normal chromosome 15 and a derivative 15, and a normal chromosome 17 and a derivative 17. Arrows mark the breakpoints on the long arms: the der(15) is lengthened by acquisition of distal 17q material, and the der(17) is shortened by loss of distal 17q to chromosome 15 with gain of the smaller distal 15q segment. This balanced reciprocal translocation corresponds to t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2), which fuses PML with RARA and is diagnostic of acute promyelocytic leukemia. The image resolution does not permit exact band-level confirmation, and FISH or RT-PCR for PML::RARA is typically used for rapid confirmation.

ddx.vs: Variant APL involves 17q21 with a different partner chromosome and is resistant to ATRA, identified by karyotype partner or RARA break-apart FISH.
Some APL cases lack a visible translocation because of submicroscopic insertion, detectable only by FISH or RT-PCR.
i(17q) produces a symmetric chromosome with two long arms and no partner derivative 15, unlike the reciprocal der(15)/der(17) pair.

2478.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞多，有許多核摺疊、胞質淡灰藍的單核球與前單核球，並夾雜少數原始細胞、有核紅血球與分葉中性球，未見原始細胞成片；呈骨髓單核球系增生，符合 JMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with mixed myelomonocytic cells
Large monocytes and promonocytes with folded nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Occasional blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, not in sheets
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Segmented neutrophils and granulocytic precursors present
2478.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a mixed population of monocytes and promonocytes showing folded nuclei and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, together with occasional blasts, granulocytic precursors, segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors. Blasts do not form sheets. Findings are consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia; correlation with peripheral monocytosis, splenomegaly, HbF level, absence of BCR-ABL1 and RAS-pathway mutation analysis is required.

ddx.vs: AMML shows >=20% blasts plus promonocytes forming a dominant population rather than a maturing myelomonocytic background.
CML marrow is granulocyte-predominant with basophilia and is BCR-ABL1 positive.
Pediatric MDS shows cytopenias with multilineage dysplasia and lacks the monocytosis and proliferative features of JMML.

2414.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中片狀的單核芽細胞樣細胞（核摺疊、腎形）之間穿插大量帶亮紅色顆粒的嗜酸性系細胞，芽細胞浸潤加上嗜酸球增多是 AML with inv(16) 在切片上的線索。
features: Diffuse sheets of immature cells effacing normal marrow architecture
Blasts with oval to folded, indented or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Numerous interspersed eosinophil precursors with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
Scattered small dark pyknotic nuclei and erythroid cells
2414.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows a hypercellular marrow diffusely replaced by sheets of immature cells with oval to folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm, consistent with myelomonocytic blasts and promonocytes. Numerous eosinophils and eosinophil precursors with brightly eosinophilic granular cytoplasm are scattered among the blasts. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not appreciated in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with increased eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/CBFB::MYH11; confirmation by cytogenetics or FISH is required.

ddx.vs: These show eosinophilia usually with fewer blasts and mast cell or MPN features, and are defined by tyrosine kinase fusions rather than CBFB::MYH11.
CEL has mature eosinophils predominating with <20% blasts, rather than sheets of myelomonocytic blasts.
Langerhans cells have grooved coffee-bean nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm with CD1a/langerin positivity, while blasts are CD34/CD117/MPO or monocytic marker positive.

2222.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見大量顆粒球，從骨髓球、後骨髓球到帶狀核與分葉核都有，呈左移的顆粒球增生，但嗜鹼性球與單核球不明顯，高倍才能細看發育不良；需配合 BCR-ABL1 陰性。
features: Markedly increased granulocytic cells at low power
Full spectrum of maturation: occasional blasts/promyelocytes, many myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Some neutrophils appear hypogranular with irregular nuclear segmentation
No obvious basophilia or monocytosis
Dysplastic detail limited by low magnification
2222.describe_en: Smear at low magnification shows a markedly increased population of granulocytic cells spanning all stages of maturation, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with few blasts. Some neutrophils appear hypogranular with irregular nuclear lobation, although dysplastic features are difficult to assess fully at this power. Basophils and monocytes are not prominent. In the context of BCR-ABL1-negative leukocytosis, findings are consistent with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: CML shows absolute basophilia and a myelocyte peak with little dysplasia, and is defined by BCR-ABL1.
Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies with normal granulation and segmentation and a clear reactive cause.
CMML has sustained monocytosis ≥10% of leukocytes, which is not seen in this field.

2094.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大量中大型母細胞佔滿，核染色質細緻、核仁明顯、細胞質淡藍，部分帶少量顆粒；其間仍有嗜酸性前驅細胞與成熟顆粒球，顯示母細胞增生伴隨成熟，符合 AML with maturation。
features: Sheets of medium to large blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin and one or more nucleoli
Moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm, some with sparse fine azurophilic granules
Occasional maturing granulocytes, including an eosinophilic precursor with coarse orange-brown granules and a band neutrophil
Scattered promyelocytes/myelocytes with more abundant granular cytoplasm
No convincing Auer rods in this field
2094.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and composed predominantly of medium to large blasts with fine chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing occasional fine granules. A minority of maturing granulocytic cells is present, including promyelocytes/myelocytes, an eosinophil precursor and band neutrophils. Auer rods are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation; cytochemistry, flow cytometry and genetic studies are needed to exclude defined genetic subtypes.

ddx.vs: It shares blasts with maturation but typically shows abundant salmon-pink granules, long Auer rods and increased eosinophil precursors; confirmation requires cytogenetics/molecular testing.

It shows myelomonocytic differentiation with abnormal eosinophils containing large purple-basophilic granules, whereas the eosinophil precursor here has orange granules without obvious monocytic component.
MDS with increased blasts has fewer than 20% blasts with multilineage dysplasia, whereas this field is dominated by blasts.

2030.recognize_zh: lambda 輕鏈免疫組織化學染色：細胞之間只有淡棕色、網狀的背景（間質血清）染色，細胞本身的細胞質幾乎不著色；與 kappa 染色強陽性對照，代表這群漿細胞是 kappa 單株性。
features: Immunoperoxidase stain for lambda light chain with hematoxylin counterstain
Faint brown reticular staining in interstitial spaces between cells
Tumor cells lack crisp intracytoplasmic lambda staining
Only rare small dark-staining cells, not a significant positive population
Densely cellular infiltrate of plasmacytoid cells with round nuclei
2030.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for lambda light chain shows only faint interstitial background staining between cells, with no convincing intracytoplasmic staining in the infiltrating plasmacytoid cells. Rare small dark cells are present but do not constitute a positive population. In conjunction with strong kappa staining of the same cells, this indicates kappa light chain restriction. Findings support a monoclonal plasma cell proliferation in post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Genuine positivity outlines the cell cytoplasm in a perinuclear pattern, whereas the staining here is extracellular and follows the interstitium.
A polyclonal infiltrate would show a substantial subset of cells with crisp cytoplasmic lambda staining alongside kappa-positive cells.
If both kappa and lambda were negative, clonality would need to be addressed by ISH for light chain mRNA or PCR for IG gene rearrangement.

1646.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 淋巴組織：中央為小淋巴球環繞、稍淡染的結節狀區域，左上方有粉紅色、帶裂隙狀管腔的血管或上皮結構，周圍混有較大淡染細胞；細胞無明顯異型，屬正常淋巴組織，但單憑此圖無法確定確切部位。
features: Lymphoid parenchyma composed predominantly of small round lymphocytes
Vaguely nodular aggregate with a slightly paler central zone of mixed larger cells
Eosinophilic structures with slit-like lumens at the upper left (vessels or epithelial elements)
Interspersed pale histiocytoid cells in surrounding areas
No cytologic atypia or sheets of large cells; resolution limits fine detail
1646.describe_en: Section of lymphoid tissue at intermediate magnification shows predominantly small round lymphocytes forming a vaguely nodular aggregate with a paler central zone, adjacent to eosinophilic structures with slit-like lumens representing vessels or epithelial elements. Scattered paler histiocytoid cells are present, and there is no cytologic atypia or sheet-like proliferation of large cells. The exact anatomic site cannot be determined from this field alone. Findings are consistent with normal lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are crowded and uniform without polarization or tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-positive in germinal center cells.
SLL diffusely effaces architecture with pale proliferation centers of prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts rather than preserved compartments.
Would show a keratin-positive epithelial meshwork with immature TdT-positive T cells and lobulation by fibrous septa.

1582.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下淋巴結結構被大小相近、邊界模糊且背靠背排列的淡染結節取代，結節內外細胞形態單調，缺乏清楚的外套層（mantle zone），呈現濾泡型淋巴瘤的結節狀生長模式。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by closely packed, vaguely nodular follicle-like structures
Nodules of similar size and shape with poorly defined borders and attenuated or absent mantle zones
Paler nodule centers composed of a monotonous population of small lymphoid cells
No tingible-body macrophages or starry-sky pattern visible at this power
Interfollicular areas also densely cellular with small lymphocytes and scattered small vessels
1582.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows effacement of the normal architecture by a vaguely nodular proliferation of closely packed, back-to-back follicle-like structures of relatively uniform size. The nodules have poorly defined borders with attenuated mantle zones and lack the polarization and tingible-body macrophages of reactive germinal centers. The neoplastic cells appear small and monotonous at this magnification. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma; grading requires high-power centroblast counts.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, are confined to the cortex, have well-formed mantle zones, polarization and tingible-body macrophages, and are BCL2-negative.
Marginal zone lymphoma shows monocytoid/marginal zone cells colonizing or surrounding residual follicles and lacks CD10/BCL6 co-expression in the neoplastic nodules.
Mantle cell lymphoma nodules consist of monotonous cells with irregular nuclei lacking centroblasts, and are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD10-negative.

1518.recognize_zh: 周邊血中多個中型淋巴樣細胞，具中等量深嗜鹼性、無顆粒的胞質，核圓形至不規則（有凹陷），染色質中度濃縮，部分可見單一明顯核仁，符合 T 前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）的前淋巴球（prolymphocytes）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small mature lymphocytes
Moderate amounts of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Round to irregular or indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Single visible nucleolus in some cells
Occasional cytoplasmic protrusions at the cell border; background red cells unremarkable
1518.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of basophilic agranular cytoplasm and round to irregular, occasionally indented nuclei. The chromatin is moderately condensed and a single nucleolus is visible in some cells. No granules or cerebriform nuclear folding are seen. Findings are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context; flow cytometry, TCL1 staining and cytogenetics for inv(14)/t(14;14) are recommended.

ddx.vs: B-PLL cells have more prominent central nucleoli and less basophilic cytoplasm and are CD19/CD20-positive by flow cytometry.
Sezary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and often lack CD7 and CD26.
ATLL cells are polylobated flower cells, CD25-positive, and associated with HTLV-1 infection.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and are CD8/CD57-positive.

61934.recognize_zh: 中央細胞的核分成三葉、染色質粗糙，淡粉紅細胞質中散布比平常明顯的紫色顆粒，屬分節嗜中性球（segmented neutrophil）並帶輕度毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）。
features: Mature granulocyte about 1.5 times red cell diameter
Nucleus segmented into three lobes connected by thin chromatin strands, with coarsely clumped chromatin
Pale pink cytoplasm containing scattered purple granules that are somewhat more prominent than usual (mild toxic granulation)
No Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles clearly identified at this resolution
Background normocytic red cells; one red cell at upper right shows fine punctate dark dots, and scattered platelets are present
61934.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mostly normocytic, normochromic red cells with adequate-appearing platelets. A mature neutrophil in the center has a three-lobed nucleus with coarse chromatin and pale cytoplasm containing scattered purple granules that are slightly coarser and more conspicuous than normal. Definite vacuolization or Döhle bodies are not appreciated. An isolated red cell at the upper right contains fine punctate inclusions of uncertain significance. Findings are consistent with a mature segmented neutrophil with mild toxic granulation, as may be seen in infection, inflammation or growth factor therapy.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophil granules are fine, lilac and barely visible, whereas toxic granules are coarser and darker purple as seen here.
Alder-Reilly granules are large dark inclusions present in all granulocytes (and often lymphocytes) persistently, without clinical infection.
Hypersegmentation requires six or more lobes (or >5% with five lobes), whereas this cell has only three lobes.

60398.recognize_zh: 這顆細胞的核呈腎形（kidney-shaped），凹陷深度不到核寬度的一半，染色質已濃縮，細胞質淡粉紅並充滿細小特異顆粒，符合後髓細胞（metamyelocyte）。
features: Cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Eccentric kidney-shaped nucleus with shallow indentation (less than half the nuclear width)
Condensed, clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Abundant pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with numerous fine specific granules
Background of normocytic red cells in peripheral blood
60398.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single granulocytic precursor among normocytic red cells. The cell has a kidney-shaped nucleus with a shallow indentation, condensed chromatin and no nucleoli, and abundant pale cytoplasm filled with specific granules. Findings are consistent with a neutrophilic metamyelocyte; its presence in blood suggests a left shift (e.g. infection, inflammation, marrow stress) and should prompt review for additional immature forms.

ddx.vs: In a band the nuclear indentation exceeds half the width of the nucleus, producing a C- or S-shaped band of uniform thickness, whereas this nucleus is only shallowly indented.
Myelocytes have a round to oval nucleus without indentation and often a visible Golgi clearing.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles, not the pink specific granules seen here.

110.recognize_zh: 淋巴結竇狀隙被大片淡染、胞質豐富的大型組織球撐開，胞質內可見完整的淋巴球與漿細胞（emperipolesis，伸入運動），且這些組織球 S100 核與胞質強陽性，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病（竇組織球增生合併巨大淋巴結病）。
features: Markedly distended lymph node sinuses filled with sheets of large histiocytes alternating with dark lymphoid cords
Histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to vacuolated cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small distinct nucleoli
Emperipolesis: intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within histiocyte cytoplasm, surrounded by clear halos (best seen on S100)
Strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S100 positivity in the large histiocytes, including a multinucleated form
Lymphoid marker IHC stains the background lymphocytes and plasma cells while the histiocytes are negative; a further marker is negative in the histiocytes
Contrast CT: enlarged left cervical nodal mass with central low attenuation
110.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the neck shows an enlarged left cervical lymph node mass with central low attenuation. Sections of the lymph node show architectural distortion by markedly dilated sinuses packed with large histiocytes, separated by cords of small lymphocytes and plasma cells. The histiocytes have abundant pale eosinophilic to finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli, and many contain intact engulfed lymphocytes and plasma cells (emperipolesis). By immunohistochemistry the histiocytes are strongly positive for S100 in both nucleus and cytoplasm, highlighting emperipolesis, whereas lymphoid markers stain only the background inflammatory cells and an additional stain is negative in the histiocytes. No atypical mitoses or malignant cells are identified in the fields shown. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy).

ddx.vs: LCH cells are smaller with grooved, reniform nuclei, are accompanied by eosinophils, and are CD1a and langerin positive, whereas RDD histiocytes are large with round nuclei, show emperipolesis and are CD1a negative.
Reactive sinus histiocytes are S100 negative and lack prominent emperipolesis and massive sinus distension.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Metastatic cells show cytologic atypia and cohesive clusters and are keratin or melanocytic marker (HMB45, Melan-A, SOX10) positive, while RDD histiocytes are cytologically bland, CD68/CD163 positive and keratin negative.

IgG4-related disease shows plasma cell-rich infiltrates with increased IgG4/IgG ratio and fibrosis without S100-positive emperipolesis-bearing histiocytes, although IgG4-positive plasma cells can be increased in RDD.

110.stain: H&E, IHC: S100 and lymphoid markers; CT
captions: Axial contrast CT neck: enlarged left cervical nodal mass with central low attenuation
Lymph node, low power: sinuses distended by pale histiocytes between lymphoid cords (H&E)
Medium power: sheets of pale histiocytes within dilated sinuses (H&E)
High power: large histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei (H&E)
High power: vacuolated histiocytes admixed with lymphocytes and plasma cells (H&E)
IHC: lymphoid marker staining background lymphocytes; histiocytes negative
IHC: positive background lymphoid cells around a negative histiocyte-rich sinus
IHC: scattered positive plasma cell/lymphoid cells; histiocytes negative
IHC: negative stain in the histiocytes
S100: strongly positive histiocytes with emperipolesis of lymphocytes
S100: positive multinucleated histiocyte containing engulfed lymphocytes
S100: histiocytes with intracytoplasmic lymphocytes surrounded by clear halos

46.recognize_zh: 此組合圖中周邊血可見胞質豐富淡染的大淋巴球（LGL 型態，但本解析度下嗜天青顆粒不易辨認），骨髓切片有成團的小型成熟淋巴球浸潤，免疫組化以 T 細胞標記標出成群的陽性細胞；配合中性球減少與 T 細胞受體基因重組呈單株性，符合 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Panel A (peripheral blood): lymphocyte with mature round nucleus and moderate to abundant pale cytoplasm, consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; azurophilic granules are not well resolved at this magnification
Panel B (core biopsy, low power): fragmented marrow with focal nodular and interstitial lymphoid aggregates
Panel C (high power): aggregate of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, without atypia
Panel D (IHC): dense clusters and interstitial scattered positive lymphocytes highlighted by a T-cell-associated marker (antigen not labeled in the image)
No overt blasts or large atypical cells in the fields shown
46.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a mature nucleus and moderate to abundant pale cytoplasm consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, although cytoplasmic granules are not well resolved at this magnification. The bone marrow core biopsy is fragmented and shows nodular and interstitial aggregates of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes without significant cytologic atypia. Immunohistochemistry (antigen not specified in the image) highlights clusters and interstitial infiltrates of positive lymphocytes; in T-LGL leukemia, CD8, TIA-1 and granzyme B typically show intrasinusoidal and interstitial clusters of cytotoxic T cells. In the setting of neutropenia and a clonal T-cell receptor gene rearrangement, findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular lymphocytosis (viral infection, post-transplant, autoimmune disease)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so persistence for more than 6 months, clonal TCR rearrangement, STAT3 mutation and loss of CD5/CD7 or KIR restriction favor the neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: Shows the same LGL morphology but is surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive with polyclonal TCR and KIR restriction.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia / small lymphocytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm form paratrabecular or interstitial infiltrates that are CD5/CD23/CD20 positive B cells rather than cytotoxic T cells.
Cells are larger with atypical nuclei and nucleoli, patients are acutely ill, and EBER in situ hybridization is positive.

66158.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群細胞核偏心、細胞質灰藍的細胞，其間夾雜淡藍白色、帶細條紋與小空泡的豐富細胞質，中央一顆細胞質呈粉紫色細纖維紋理，局部可聯想到 Gaucher 細胞的「皺紙樣」（wrinkled tissue paper）細胞質；但典型皺紙紋理並不清楚，需搭配酵素活性確認。
features: Aggregate of cells with small round eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Pale blue-white cytoplasmic areas with fine striations and small vacuoles between the nuclei, suggestive of storage-cell cytoplasm
One central cell with abundant pink-purple, finely fibrillar/striated cytoplasm
No nuclear atypia, mitoses or high N:C ratio in the aggregate
Background of intact erythrocytes; the classic crumpled 'tissue paper' texture is only focally appreciated at this resolution
66158.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive-appearing aggregate of cells with small, round, eccentric nuclei and moderate to abundant cytoplasm. Between the nuclei there are pale blue-white cytoplasmic areas with fine striations and small vacuoles, and a central cell shows pink-purple fibrillar cytoplasm, features that suggest lipid-storage histiocytes. The characteristic crumpled 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm is only focally suggested, and individual cell borders are hard to resolve, so the morphology is not diagnostic on its own. In the given clinical context, findings are suggestive of Gaucher cells; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 genotyping is required.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically near-identical and are separated by the underlying neoplasm or hemoglobinopathy and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have bubbly, uniformly vacuolated 'foamy' cytoplasm rather than fibrillar striations, and sphingomyelinase deficiency is confirmatory.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green ceroid granules on Romanowsky stains instead of a finely striated cytoplasm.
Plasma cells and osteoblasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof or pale zone and lack the abundant pale fibrillar storage cytoplasm.

1774.recognize_zh: 胸水細胞離心抹片中央有一小團5顆緊密相貼、核互相擠壓（molding）的小圓細胞，核質比高、細胞質極少，與周圍散在的巨噬細胞明顯不同；這種小圓藍細胞團塊符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤（neuroblastoma）。
features: Tight cohesive cluster of about five small round tumor cells with nuclear molding
High N:C ratio with scant, pale to basophilic cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved
Scattered larger reactive macrophages/mesothelial cells with abundant frothy cytoplasm around the cluster
Paucicellular background; low magnification limits cytologic detail and no neuropil or rosettes are seen
1774.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of pleural fluid shows a paucicellular background of scattered macrophages and mesothelial cells. In the center there is a tight cohesive cluster of small round cells with high N:C ratios, scant cytoplasm, and nuclear molding, distinct from the background reactive cells. Rosettes or fibrillary neuropil are not identified, and the low magnification limits assessment of chromatin and nucleoli. In a child with a known adrenal/paraspinal mass, findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma; confirmation by immunocytochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are discohesive single cells without molding and are TdT/CD3 or CD19 positive rather than PHOX2B positive.
Mesothelial cells have more abundant dense cytoplasm, windows between cells, and calretinin positivity.

ddx.dx: Other small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Separated by immunostains such as CD99/NKX2.2 for Ewing and myogenin/desmin for rhabdomyosarcoma.
Occurs in adults with similar molding but is keratin positive and PHOX2B negative.

4206.recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟切片可見紅髓瀰漫性被密集的淋巴樣細胞浸潤，失去正常紅髓白髓分界，另有數個淡灰藍、細胞稀少的無定形區；需結合臨床（傳染性單核球增多症、脾破裂）與高倍、免疫染色才能判讀。
features: Diffusely hypercellular parenchyma with loss of the normal white pulp/red pulp demarcation
Dense infiltrate of small dark nuclei throughout the red pulp
Several pale gray-blue, hypocellular amorphous zones (possible edema, fibrin or hemorrhage; not resolvable at this power)
Thin linear clefts, likely sectioning artifact
Cytologic detail (immunoblasts) cannot be assessed at this magnification
4206.describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows diffusely hypercellular parenchyma with effacement of the usual white pulp/red pulp distinction by a dense lymphoid infiltrate. Several pale, hypocellular amorphous areas are present, which may represent edema, fibrin deposition or hemorrhage but cannot be characterized at this magnification. Individual cell morphology, including immunoblasts, is not assessable. In the appropriate clinical setting these findings are consistent with the red pulp expansion of infectious mononucleosis predisposing to splenic rupture, but they are not specific on their own.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving spleen
ddx.vs: DLBCL typically forms destructive nodular masses of monotonous large B cells, whereas infectious mononucleosis shows a polymorphous T-cell-rich infiltrate with scattered EBER-positive immunoblasts.
HSTCL shows sinusoidal infiltration by monotonous medium-sized gamma-delta T cells with atrophic white pulp, rather than a polymorphous reactive infiltrate.
Congestive spleen shows dilated sinusoids with fibrosis of cords and little lymphoid infiltrate.

1710.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中同時可見各階段的顆粒球系（骨髓細胞、後髓細胞、帶狀及分葉核）、帶粗大深色顆粒的嗜酸性系細胞，以及箭頭所指核圓且緻密的晚期有核紅血球，細胞形態成熟有序、無明顯發育不良；這是正常骨髓三系造血的樣貌。
features: Mixed granulocytic maturation: myelocytes and metamyelocytes with pale granular cytoplasm, band and segmented forms
Eosinophil-lineage cells with coarse dark-orange granules (lower left and lower right)
Arrowed late erythroid precursor with a round, dense nucleus and scant cytoplasm
Cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm (center) consistent with an early erythroid precursor
Orderly nuclear-cytoplasmic maturation without dysplastic features or excess blasts
1710.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixture of hematopoietic cells at various stages of maturation, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, eosinophilic precursors with coarse granules, and erythroid precursors ranging from a basophilic-cytoplasm early form to the arrowed late normoblast with a round, condensed nucleus. Maturation is orderly, with synchronous nuclear and cytoplasmic development and no morphologic dysplasia. Blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with normal trilineage hematopoiesis, although megakaryocytes and overall cellularity cannot be assessed from a single high-power field.

60142.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中有一顆大型胚細胞（blast），核大、染色質細緻、核質比高，外圍有中等量嗜鹼性（藍色）細胞質，細胞質無明顯顆粒；右下角的小淋巴球可作為大小對照。僅憑形態無法分辨譜系，需流式細胞儀確定為混合表型急性白血病。
features: Large blast (approximately 2–2.5 times the diameter of a small lymphocyte) with irregular, angular outline
High N:C ratio with a large, slightly irregular nucleus
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli are faintly visible at best
Moderate rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Small mature lymphocyte in lower right for size comparison; red cells largely normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
60142.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large circulating blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a moderate amount of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen. A small mature lymphocyte is present for size comparison, and the red cells show no significant poikilocytosis; platelets are not evident in this field. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage; findings are consistent with circulating blasts of acute leukemia and, with flow cytometric demonstration of both myeloid/monocytic and B-lymphoid lineage markers and KMT2A rearrangement, support mixed phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes can look identical, and separation requires flow cytometry showing absence of B- or T-lineage–defining markers (CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10, or cytoplasmic CD3).
B-ALL blasts are often smaller with scant cytoplasm, and MPAL is distinguished only by additional MPO or monocytic differentiation markers on flow or cytochemistry.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or atypical lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin, abundant pale-blue cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells, and no nucleoli.
